### Create `apps/api/test/integration/activity-harness.ts`

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { expect } from "vitest";
import { ActivityPage, ActivitySettings, ErrorEnvelope, FlowResponse, MeResponse, PostView, type ActivityEntry } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAccount } from "../../src/account";
import { createActivity } from "../../src/activity";
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";
import { createAuth } from "../../src/auth";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createModeration } from "../../src/moderation";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { createSocial, socialForModeration } from "../../src/social";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { casesMedia, removeFixtures, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";

/** 2d's three tables (migration 0049_activity), which every activity suite leaves as it found them. */
export const ACTIVITY_TABLES = ["activity_items", "activity_state", "post_mentions"];

/** One account of a suite: its browser with a signed-in, onboarded session, its id and its handle. */
export interface Member {
  b: Browser;
  id: string;
  handle: string;
}

export interface ActivityHarnessOptions {
  /** Entries a page of Activity holds; ACTIVITY_PAGE_SIZE unless a suite lowers it to page through few entries. */
  pageSize?: number;
}

/**
 * The real app for the activity suites (2d design, section 12.3): the auth, social, moderation, account and activity
 * modules built as the server builds them, on the test database, with an in-memory limit store and mailer. `signUp`
 * makes an account over HTTP and ages its profile as only the migrator may (three days unless said, so quoting and the
 * age rule of `older` pass). Every account it made, and what hangs on it, goes with `close` (removeFixtures), so a suite
 * leaves 2d's tables as it found them; `counts` reads them for a suite's own last test.
 */
export async function activityHarness(options: ActivityHarnessOptions = {}) {
  const config = loadConfig();
  const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
  const authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
  const apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
  const migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
  const auth = createAuth({
    config,
    logger,
    authDb,
    kv: new MemoryKv(),
    mailer,
    profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb),
    turnstile: { verify: async () => true },
    breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
  });
  const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: auth.forModeration, social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), requireSession: auth.requireSession, rateLimitStore, config, logger });
  const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(), moderation: moderation.forSocial });
  const activity = createActivity({ apiDb, social: social.forActivity, moderation: moderation.forActivity, rateLimitStore, requireSession: auth.requireSession, logger, pageSize: options.pageSize });
  const account = createAccount({
    auth: auth.forAccount,
    social: social.forAccount,
    media: { purgeOwner: async () => [], requestDeletion: async () => undefined, exportImages: async () => [] },
    moderation: moderation.forAccount,
    activity: activity.forAccount,
    requireSession: auth.requireSession,
    requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(),
    requireStrongFreshAuth: auth.requireStrongFreshAuth(),
    rateLimitStore,
    logger,
  });
  const app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, social, moderation, account, activity });
  const made: string[] = [];
  const before = await rowCounts(apiDb, ACTIVITY_TABLES);

  /** Sets the profile's age in hours, as only the migrator may. */
  const age = (id: string, hours: number) => migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set created_at = now() - make_interval(secs => ${hours * 3_600}) where id = ${id}::uuid`);

  /** A signed-in, onboarded web account, its profile `ageHours` old (three days unless said). */
  async function signUp(ageHours = 72): Promise<Member> {
    const b = new Browser(app, config.APP_ORIGIN);
    const email = `activity-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = `a${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`;
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: "ok", deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/verify", { json: { flowId, code: mailer.lastCodeFor(email) } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: `User ${handle}` } })).status).toBe(200);
    const id = MeResponse.parse(await (await b.fetch("/api/me")).json()).user.id;
    made.push(id);
    await age(id, ageHours);
    return { b, id, handle };
  }

  /** Posts as `m` and answers the view; `extra` names a reply's parent or a quote's post, or hides the counts. */
  async function post(m: Member, body: string, extra: { replyToId?: string; quoteOfId?: string; hideCounts?: boolean } = {}): Promise<PostView> {
    const res = await m.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body, ...extra } });
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(201);
    return PostView.parse(await res.json());
  }

  /** A relation from `m` to `other` over HTTP, and its answer's status. */
  const relate = async (m: Member, other: Member, what: "follow" | "block" | "mute", on = true) => (await m.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${other.handle}/${what}`, { method: on ? "POST" : "DELETE" })).status;

  /** One page of `m`'s Activity, checked against the contract. */
  async function page(m: Member, query: { tab?: "all" | "conversations"; cursor?: string } = {}): Promise<ActivityPage> {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (query.tab) params.set("tab", query.tab);
    if (query.cursor) params.set("cursor", query.cursor);
    const res = await m.b.fetch(`/api/activity${params.size > 0 ? `?${params}` : ""}`);
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return ActivityPage.parse(await res.json());
  }

  /** Every page of `m`'s Activity, followed cursor by cursor. */
  async function all(m: Member, tab: "all" | "conversations" = "all"): Promise<ActivityEntry[]> {
    const items: ActivityEntry[] = [];
    let cursor: string | undefined;
    for (let n = 0; n < 50; n++) {
      const got = await page(m, { tab, cursor });
      items.push(...got.items);
      if (got.nextCursor === null) return items;
      cursor = got.nextCursor;
    }
    throw new Error("Activity did not end in fifty pages");
  }

  /** What a list says, entry by entry: a post entry's kind and post, a group's day and accounts, a notice's kind and id. */
  const summary = (items: readonly ActivityEntry[]) =>
    items.map((entry) =>
      entry.type === "post" ? `${entry.kind}:${entry.post.id}` : entry.type === "follows" ? `follows:${entry.key.slice(2)}:${entry.count}:${entry.actors.map((a) => a.handle).join(",")}` : `${entry.kind}:${entry.id}`,
    );

  /** `m`'s rules, set over HTTP. */
  async function settings(m: Member, rules: Partial<ActivitySettings>): Promise<ActivitySettings> {
    const current = ActivitySettings.parse(await (await m.b.fetch("/api/activity/settings")).json());
    const res = await m.b.fetch("/api/activity/settings", { method: "PUT", json: { ...current, ...rules } });
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return ActivitySettings.parse(await res.json());
  }

  /** The error code of a refused answer. */
  const code = async (res: Response) => ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error.code;

  /** The entries of `recipient` as stored, oldest first: kind, actor and post. */
  const stored = async (recipientId: string) =>
    (
      await migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; actor_id: string; post_id: string | null }>(
        sql`select kind::text as kind, actor_id, post_id from activity_items where recipient_id = ${recipientId}::uuid order by created_at, id`,
      )
    ).map((row) => ({ kind: row.kind, actor: row.actor_id, post: row.post_id }));

  return {
    config,
    app,
    apiDb,
    migrateDb,
    social,
    activity,
    moderation,
    made,
    age,
    signUp,
    post,
    relate,
    page,
    all,
    summary,
    settings,
    code,
    stored,
    /** 2d's tables as they stand now. */
    counts: () => rowCounts(apiDb, ACTIVITY_TABLES),
    /** What they held before the suite's first test. */
    before,
    /** Removes every account the suite made, with what hangs on them, and closes the pools. */
    async close(): Promise<void> {
      try {
        await removeFixtures(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
      } finally {
        await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
      }
    },
    /** Removes the accounts made so far, for a suite's last test that holds the tables to what they were. */
    async removeMade(): Promise<void> {
      await removeFixtures(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    },
  };
}

export type ActivityHarness = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof activityHarness>>;
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/activity-moderation.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ACTIVITY_PAGE_SIZE, AuthorCasesPage, type ActivityEntry } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { activityPage } from "../../src/activity/flows";
import { storedImageName } from "../../src/media/files";
import { activityHarness, type ActivityHarness } from "./activity-harness";
import { matchForTest } from "./automation-fixtures";
import { decideForTest, leavesNoModerationRows, suspendForTest } from "./moderation-decide";
import { aPost, ground, intake, newImageRow, newPostRow, saveText, uuids } from "./moderation-fixtures";

// Decisions are real, confirmed with a staff key; the suites around them sign accounts up over HTTP.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 240_000 });

/** A time as the database writes Activity's: ISO in UTC to the microsecond. */
const MICROS = sql.raw(`'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'`);

/**
 * Moderation entries of Activity (2d design, section 5.5.2; section 12.3): read only from the reads the author's own Cases
 * and Notices use and from lost_told_for, never written; listed no earlier than the author may be told and no older than
 * 90 days by the told time; merged with the social entries by (at, key) into one stable order across pages.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: moderation entries in Activity", () => {
  let h: ActivityHarness;
  /** Rows this file wrote that no fixture removes: releases and quarantine files, by id. */
  const releases: string[] = [];
  const lostMedia: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    h = await activityHarness();
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await h?.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from quarantine_files where media_id = any(${uuids(lostMedia)})`);
      await h?.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from releases where id = any(${uuids(releases)})`);
    } finally {
      await h?.close();
    }
  }, 120_000);

  const signUp = () => h.signUp();
  const moderation = (items: readonly ActivityEntry[]) => items.filter((entry) => entry.type === "moderation");
  /** A decision's id and when its author was told, to the microsecond. */
  const decisionsOf = async (postId: string) =>
    h.migrateDb.execute<{ id: string; kind: string; at: string | null; told: boolean }>(sql`
      select d.id, d.kind::text as kind, to_char(d.informed_at at time zone 'UTC', ${MICROS}) as at, (d.author_mail <> 'none' and d.informed_at is not null) as told
        from decisions d join cases c on c.id = d.case_id where c.target_type = 'post' and c.target_id = ${postId}::uuid order by d.decided_at, d.id`);
  /** A release of these posts, as the command line's replay writes one (no seal, no admin), and its notice as given. */
  async function releaseOf(postIds: string[], notice: string): Promise<{ id: string; at: string }> {
    const [row] = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ id: string; at: string }>(sql`
      insert into releases (post_ids, basis, released_at, replay_of, backups_clear_at, author_notice)
      values (${uuids(postIds)}, 'period', now(), gen_random_uuid(), now() + interval '30 days', 'none')
      returning id, to_char(released_at at time zone 'UTC', ${MICROS}) as at`);
    releases.push(row!.id);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update releases set author_notice = ${notice} where id = ${row!.id}::uuid`);
    return row!;
  }

  test("a decision told to its author is an entry about its post, at the time it was told; one its author was told nothing of, one held untold and one the dispatch has not told yet make none, until told", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp();
    const post = await h.post(ada, "a post a decision withholds");
    await decideForTest(h.apiDb, post.id, "withheld");
    const [withhold] = await decisionsOf(post.id);
    expect(withhold).toMatchObject({ kind: "interim", told: true });
    const entry = { type: "moderation", kind: "decision", key: `d:${withhold!.id}`, at: withhold!.at, new: true, target: "post", id: withhold!.id, postId: post.id, postCreatedAt: post.createdAt };
    expect((await h.page(ada)).items).toEqual([entry]);
    // Told nothing: 3c's silent decisions carry author_mail none.
    const [mail] = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ state: string }>(sql`select author_mail::text as state from decisions where id = ${withhold!.id}::uuid`);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update decisions set author_mail = 'none' where id = ${withhold!.id}::uuid`);
    expect((await h.page(ada)).items).toEqual([]);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update decisions set author_mail = ${mail!.state}::delivery_state where id = ${withhold!.id}::uuid`);
    // Held with an order's notice, and then not yet told by the dispatch: informed_at is null, with no mail
    // (decisions_informed), until the dispatch tells it.
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update decisions set informed_at = null, author_mail = 'none' where id = ${withhold!.id}::uuid`);
    expect((await h.page(ada)).items).toEqual([]);
    expect(moderation(await h.all(ada, "all"))).toEqual([]);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update decisions set informed_at = ${withhold!.at}::timestamptz, author_mail = ${mail!.state}::delivery_state where id = ${withhold!.id}::uuid`);
    expect((await h.page(ada)).items).toEqual([entry]);
    // The tab Conversations keeps none.
    expect((await h.page(ada, { tab: "conversations" })).items).toEqual([]);
    // Restored: every decision the author was told of is an entry, newest first, and no other.
    await decideForTest(h.apiDb, post.id, "visible");
    const told = (await decisionsOf(post.id)).filter((row) => row.told).map((row) => `decision:${row.id}`).reverse();
    expect(h.summary((await h.page(ada)).items)).toEqual(told);
  });

  test("a decision about the account names the account; a report about the recipient, the finding a decision rests on and a staff note never appear", async () => {
    const [cat, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const reported = await h.post(cat, "a post someone reports");
    const { decisionId, basisDecisionId } = await suspendForTest(h.apiDb, cat.id);
    const items = moderation(await h.all(cat));
    expect(items.find((entry) => entry.id === decisionId)).toMatchObject({ kind: "decision", target: "account", postId: null, postCreatedAt: null });
    expect(items.find((entry) => entry.id === basisDecisionId)).toMatchObject({ kind: "decision", target: "post" });
    // Bob's report of Cat's post and a staff note on its case: neither is anything Cat's reads may name.
    const recorded = await intake(h.apiDb, ground.rule(bob.id, "R1"), aPost(reported.id));
    const caseId = recorded.items[0]!.caseId!;
    const [decider] = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select decided_by as id from decisions where id = ${decisionId}::uuid`);
    await saveText(h.apiDb, caseId, decider!.id, "note");
    // decideForTest's own decisions removed below include this post's case: it is the suite's to decide.
    await decideForTest(h.apiDb, reported.id, "withheld");
    const after = moderation(await h.all(cat));
    const [told] = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`
      select count(*)::int as n from decisions d join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
       where ((c.target_type = 'account' and c.target_id = ${cat.id}::uuid) or c.target_id in (select id from posts where author_id = ${cat.id}::uuid))
         and d.author_mail <> 'none' and d.informed_at is not null`);
    expect(after).toHaveLength(told!.n);
    expect(after.every((entry) => entry.kind === "decision")).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a decision told 91 days ago is no entry, one told 89 days ago is; the Cases screen lists both", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp();
    const [old, recent] = [await h.post(ada, "decided long ago"), await h.post(ada, "decided a while ago")];
    await decideForTest(h.apiDb, old.id, "withheld");
    await decideForTest(h.apiDb, recent.id, "withheld");
    const [[oldDecision], [recentDecision]] = [await decisionsOf(old.id), await decisionsOf(recent.id)];
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update decisions set informed_at = now() - interval '91 days' where id = ${oldDecision!.id}::uuid`);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update decisions set informed_at = now() - interval '89 days' where id = ${recentDecision!.id}::uuid`);
    expect(moderation(await h.all(ada)).map((entry) => entry.id)).toEqual([recentDecision!.id]);
    const cases = AuthorCasesPage.parse(await (await ada.b.fetch("/api/moderation/cases")).json());
    expect(cases.decisions.map((row) => row.id).sort()).toEqual([oldDecision!.id, recentDecision!.id].sort());
  });

  test("a release whose notice is held makes no entry until its hold ends; a refused upload and a lost image the dispatch told are entries; the merge with the social entries keeps one order across pages, ties included", async () => {
    const [ada, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const root = await h.post(ada, "a post of ada's");
    const replies = [await h.post(bob, "reply one", { replyToId: root.id }), await h.post(bob, "reply two", { replyToId: root.id }), await h.post(bob, "reply three", { replyToId: root.id })];
    // A release of Ada's post, its notice held: nothing; then pending, as releaseHeldNotices moves it once the hold ends.
    const release = await releaseOf([root.id], "held");
    expect(moderation((await h.page(ada)).items)).toEqual([]);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update releases set author_notice = 'pending' where id = ${release.id}::uuid`);
    expect(moderation((await h.page(ada)).items)).toEqual([{ type: "moderation", kind: "release", key: `r:${release.id}`, at: release.at, new: true, target: "account", id: release.id, postId: null, postCreatedAt: null }]);
    // A refused upload: an image on no post, refused for an acting match.
    const upload = await newImageRow(h.migrateDb, ada.id, null);
    const matchId = await matchForTest(h.migrateDb, upload, "acting");
    const [refusal] = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ id: string; at: string }>(sql`
      insert into upload_refusals (media_id, owner_id, match_id, refused_at) values (${upload}::uuid, ${ada.id}::uuid, ${matchId}::uuid, now())
      returning id, to_char(refused_at at time zone 'UTC', ${MICROS}) as at`);
    // A lost image of a post of Ada's: no entry while its mail is pending, one once 3d's dispatch told it.
    const lostPost = await newPostRow(h.migrateDb, ada.id);
    const lost = await newImageRow(h.migrateDb, ada.id, lostPost);
    lostMedia.push(lost);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into quarantine_files (media_id, file, lost_at) values (${lost}::uuid, ${storedImageName(lost, "small")}, now())`);
    expect(moderation(await h.all(ada)).map((entry) => entry.kind).sort()).toEqual(["release", "upload"]);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`select public.lost_told(${lost}::uuid, 'sent'::delivery_state)`);
    const [lostRow] = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ at: string; created: string }>(sql`
      select to_char(q.lost_at at time zone 'UTC', ${MICROS}) as at, to_char(p.created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as created
        from quarantine_files q join posts p on p.id = ${lostPost}::uuid where q.media_id = ${lost}::uuid`);
    const items = moderation(await h.all(ada));
    expect(items.find((entry) => entry.kind === "upload")).toEqual({ type: "moderation", kind: "upload", key: `u:${refusal!.id}`, at: refusal!.at, new: true, target: "account", id: refusal!.id, postId: null, postCreatedAt: null });
    expect(items.find((entry) => entry.kind === "lost")).toEqual({ type: "moderation", kind: "lost", key: `l:${lost}`, at: lostRow!.at, new: true, target: "post", id: lost, postId: lostPost, postCreatedAt: lostRow!.created });

    // Ties: the release, the refusal and the loss at the second reply's time exactly. Keys then decide, highest first: u, r,
    // l, then e.
    const [tie] = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select created_at::text as at from activity_items where post_id = ${replies[1]!.id}::uuid`);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update releases set released_at = ${tie!.at}::timestamptz where id = ${release.id}::uuid`);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update upload_refusals set refused_at = ${tie!.at}::timestamptz where id = ${refusal!.id}::uuid`);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update quarantine_files set lost_at = ${tie!.at}::timestamptz where media_id = ${lost}::uuid`);
    const whole = await activityPage(h.activity.deps, ada.id, { tab: "all" });
    expect(whole.items).toHaveLength(6);
    expect(whole.nextCursor).toBeNull();
    const keys = whole.items.map((entry) => entry.key);
    const atTie = whole.items.filter((entry) => entry.at === whole.items.find((e) => e.type === "post" && e.post.id === replies[1]!.id)!.at).map((entry) => entry.key.slice(0, 1));
    expect(atTie).toEqual(["u", "r", "l", "e"]);
    // Every page size gives the same entries in the same order, each once.
    for (const size of [1, 2, 4]) {
      const paged: string[] = [];
      let cursor: string | undefined;
      for (let n = 0; n < 20; n++) {
        const got = await activityPage({ ...h.activity.deps, pageSize: size }, ada.id, { tab: "all", cursor });
        expect(got.items.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(size);
        paged.push(...got.items.map((entry) => entry.key));
        if (got.nextCursor === null) break;
        cursor = got.nextCursor;
      }
      expect(paged, `pages of ${size}`).toEqual(keys);
    }
    expect(ACTIVITY_PAGE_SIZE).toBe(30);
  });

  leavesNoModerationRows(() => h.apiDb);

  test("this file left no row behind: the accounts it made go with what hangs on them, and 2d's tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from quarantine_files where media_id = any(${uuids(lostMedia.splice(0))})`);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from releases where id = any(${uuids(releases.splice(0))})`);
    await h.removeMade();
    expect(await h.counts()).toEqual(h.before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/activity-retention.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ACTIVITY_KEEP_DAYS } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { createActivityRepo } from "../../src/activity/repo";
import { RETENTION_BATCH, RETENTION_JOB, createRetentionJob } from "../../src/activity/retention";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryJobLock } from "../../src/lib/jobs";
import { ACTIVITY_TABLES } from "./activity-harness";
import { newPostRow, removeFixtures, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 60_000 });

/**
 * The job activity-retention (2d design, sections 5.10 and 11.1; decision 11; section 12.3): entries written more than
 * ACTIVITY_KEEP_DAYS ago go, in batches by id until a batch comes back short; younger ones stay; the round runs under the
 * job's lock, and logs only how many went.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: activity-retention", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  const made: string[] = [];
  let recipient: string;
  /** Entries of the recipient by age in days, as the migrator wrote them (it alone may date an entry). */
  const ids: Record<number, string[]> = {};

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, ACTIVITY_TABLES);
    const [r, actor] = [await newProfile(migrateDb), await newProfile(migrateDb)];
    made.push(r.id, actor.id);
    recipient = r.id;
    // Five entries 91 days old, two 89 days old and one of today, each a mention in a post of its own.
    for (const [days, n] of [
      [91, 5],
      [89, 2],
      [0, 1],
    ] as const) {
      ids[days] = [];
      for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) {
        const post = await newPostRow(migrateDb, actor.id);
        const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into activity_items (recipient_id, kind, actor_id, post_id, created_at)
          values (${recipient}::uuid, 'mention', ${actor.id}::uuid, ${post}::uuid, now() - make_interval(days => ${days}::int))
          returning id`);
        ids[days]!.push(row!.id);
      }
    }
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    try {
      await removeFixtures(migrateDb, made);
    } finally {
      await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
    }
  });

  const kept = async () =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from activity_items where recipient_id = ${recipient}::uuid order by id`)).map((row) => row.id);
  /** A logger that keeps what the job logs. */
  function recorder() {
    const lines: { level: string; fields: Record<string, unknown>; message: string }[] = [];
    const log = pino({ level: "silent" });
    for (const level of ["info", "warn", "error"] as const) {
      log[level] = ((fields: Record<string, unknown>, message: string) => {
        lines.push({ level, fields, message });
      }) as never;
    }
    return { log, lines };
  }

  test("the batch is 5,000 entries, the keep 90 days, and the job is named activity-retention", () => {
    expect(RETENTION_BATCH).toBe(5_000);
    expect(ACTIVITY_KEEP_DAYS).toBe(90);
    expect(RETENTION_JOB).toBe("activity-retention");
  });

  test("while another instance holds the job's lock, a round is skipped and deletes nothing", async () => {
    const lock = new MemoryJobLock();
    expect(await lock.acquire(`job:${RETENTION_JOB}`, "another instance", 60_000)).toBe(true);
    const { log } = recorder();
    expect(await createRetentionJob({ repo: createActivityRepo(apiDb), log }, lock, 2).round()).toBe("skipped");
    expect((await kept()).length).toBe(8);
  });

  test("a round deletes the entries older than 90 days in batches until one comes back short, keeps those of 89 days and today, and logs only the count", async () => {
    // Nothing older than the keep but this file's own entries, so the batches below are this file's to count.
    const [others] = await migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(
      sql`select count(*)::int as n from activity_items where created_at < now() - make_interval(days => ${ACTIVITY_KEEP_DAYS}::int) and recipient_id <> ${recipient}::uuid`,
    );
    expect(others!.n).toBe(0);
    const repo = createActivityRepo(apiDb);
    const batches: number[] = [];
    const counted = { ...repo, deleteExpired: async (batch: number) => {
      const gone = await repo.deleteExpired(batch);
      batches.push(gone);
      return gone;
    } };
    const { log, lines } = recorder();
    expect(await createRetentionJob({ repo: counted, log }, new MemoryJobLock(), 2).round()).toBe("ran");
    expect(batches).toEqual([2, 2, 1]);
    expect(await kept()).toEqual([...ids[89]!, ...ids[0]!].sort());
    expect(lines).toEqual([{ level: "info", fields: { job: RETENTION_JOB, deleted: 5 }, message: "activity: old entries deleted" }]);
    // A round with nothing to delete logs nothing.
    const quiet = recorder();
    expect(await createRetentionJob({ repo, log: quiet.log }, new MemoryJobLock(), 2).round()).toBe("ran");
    expect(quiet.lines).toEqual([]);
    expect((await kept()).length).toBe(3);
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: 2d's tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb, ACTIVITY_TABLES)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/http-activity.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ACTIVITY_DEFAULTS, ACTIVITY_NEWER_CAP, ActivityNewerResponse, ActivitySettings } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { activityPage } from "../../src/activity/flows";
import { activityHarness, type ActivityHarness, type Member } from "./activity-harness";
import { decideForTest, leavesNoModerationRows } from "./moderation-decide";
import { liftRowForTest, suspendRowForTest } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";

// Every test signs accounts up over HTTP and some decide on posts with a real staff key: slow on a loaded machine.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

const DAY_MS = 86_400_000;

/**
 * Activity over HTTP (2d design, sections 5.1 to 5.8 and 9.2; section 12.3): each kind written by its act and read on the
 * recipient's list, under the recipient's rules, hidden and shown again as the facts after the act change, grouped by UTC
 * day for follows, with the seen marker, `new` and the newer count. The real app, with every module Activity reads.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: Activity over HTTP", () => {
  let h: ActivityHarness;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    h = await activityHarness();
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await h?.close();
  }, 120_000);

  const signUp = (hours?: number) => h.signUp(hours);
  const newer = async (m: Member, query = "") => {
    const res = await m.b.fetch(`/api/activity/newer${query}`);
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return ActivityNewerResponse.parse(await res.json()).count;
  };

  test("each kind is written by its act and read on the recipient's list: a reply, a quote, a mention and a follow; a reply that names its parent's author is one reply entry, and the thread's root is not told", async () => {
    const [ada, bob, cat] = [await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const root = await h.post(ada, "a post of ada's");
    const reply = await h.post(bob, `a reply that also names @${ada.handle}`, { replyToId: root.id });
    const quote = await h.post(bob, "a quote", { quoteOfId: root.id });
    const mention = await h.post(bob, `hello @${ada.handle.toUpperCase()}, and @${cat.handle}`);
    expect(await h.relate(bob, ada, "follow")).toBe(200);
    // Cat answers Bob's reply: Bob is told, Ada (the thread's root) is not.
    const deeper = await h.post(cat, "a reply to the reply", { replyToId: reply.id });

    const page = await h.page(ada);
    const day = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    expect(h.summary(page.items)).toEqual([`follows:${day}:1:${bob.handle}`, `mention:${mention.id}`, `quote:${quote.id}`, `reply:${reply.id}`]);
    expect(await h.stored(ada.id)).toEqual([
      { kind: "reply", actor: bob.id, post: reply.id },
      { kind: "quote", actor: bob.id, post: quote.id },
      { kind: "mention", actor: bob.id, post: mention.id },
      { kind: "follow", actor: bob.id, post: null },
    ]);
    // A post entry carries the post's view, with its mentions that link for the reader; a group its accounts.
    const mentioned = page.items.find((entry) => entry.type === "post" && entry.kind === "mention");
    expect(mentioned?.type === "post" && mentioned.post.mentions).toEqual([ada.handle, cat.handle]);
    expect(page.items[0]).toMatchObject({ type: "follows", key: `f:${day}`, count: 1, actors: [{ id: bob.id, handle: bob.handle }], new: true });
    expect(page.seenAt).toBeNull();
    expect(page.nextCursor).toBeNull();
    // Times are the database's, to the microsecond, newest first.
    expect(page.items.every((entry, n) => n === 0 || entry.at <= page.items[n - 1]!.at)).toBe(true);
    // Conversations keeps replies, mentions and quotes.
    expect(h.summary((await h.page(ada, { tab: "conversations" })).items)).toEqual([`mention:${mention.id}`, `quote:${quote.id}`, `reply:${reply.id}`]);
    expect(h.summary((await h.page(bob)).items)).toEqual([`reply:${deeper.id}`]);
    expect(h.summary((await h.page(cat)).items)).toEqual([`mention:${mention.id}`]);
  });

  test("the first ten mentions are told, the author and the accounts already told of the post not counted; every live handle up to twenty is stored", async () => {
    const [ada, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const root = await h.post(ada, "a post to answer");
    // Twelve accounts that never sign in: a mention needs only a live profile.
    const named: { id: string; handle: string }[] = [];
    for (let n = 0; n < 12; n++) {
      const profile = await newProfile(h.apiDb);
      h.made.push(profile.id);
      named.push(profile);
    }
    // The author, the parent's author and a handle nobody holds come first; then the twelve.
    const body = `@${bob.handle} @${ada.handle} @nobody_${Date.now() % 1_000_000} ${named.map((p) => `@${p.handle}`).join(" ")}`;
    const reply = await h.post(bob, body, { replyToId: root.id });
    expect(reply.mentions).toEqual([bob.handle, ada.handle, ...named.map((p) => p.handle)]);
    // Ada is told once, of the reply; the first ten of the twelve of a mention; the last two of nothing; Bob of nothing.
    expect(await h.stored(ada.id)).toEqual([{ kind: "reply", actor: bob.id, post: reply.id }]);
    for (const [n, profile] of named.entries()) expect(await h.stored(profile.id), `mention ${n + 1}`).toEqual(n < 10 ? [{ kind: "mention", actor: bob.id, post: reply.id }] : []);
    expect(await h.stored(bob.id)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("the recipient's rules: Everyone, Accounts older than 2 days (47 hours refused, 49 passed), Accounts you follow and Off for replies, mentions and quotes, and the follow switch; a rule applies to new acts only", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp();
    const [young, older, stranger, friend, quoter, follower, later] = [await signUp(47), await signUp(49), await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp()];
    expect(await h.settings(ada, { replies: "older", mentions: "following", quotes: "off", follows: false })).toEqual({ replies: "older", mentions: "following", quotes: "off", follows: false });
    const root = await h.post(ada, "a post of ada's");
    const fromYoung = await h.post(young, "a reply from a new account", { replyToId: root.id });
    const fromOlder = await h.post(older, "a reply from an older one", { replyToId: root.id });
    expect(await h.relate(ada, friend, "follow")).toBe(200);
    const fromStranger = await h.post(stranger, `hello @${ada.handle}`);
    const fromFriend = await h.post(friend, `hello @${ada.handle}`);
    const quoted = await h.post(quoter, "a quote", { quoteOfId: root.id });
    expect(await h.relate(follower, ada, "follow")).toBe(200);
    expect(h.summary((await h.page(ada)).items)).toEqual([`mention:${fromFriend.id}`, `reply:${fromOlder.id}`]);
    // A changed rule brings nothing back, and lets the next act in.
    await h.settings(ada, { replies: "everyone", mentions: "everyone", quotes: "everyone", follows: true });
    expect(await h.relate(later, ada, "follow")).toBe(200);
    const day = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    expect(h.summary((await h.page(ada)).items)).toEqual([`follows:${day}:1:${later.handle}`, `mention:${fromFriend.id}`, `reply:${fromOlder.id}`]);
    const stored = (await h.stored(ada.id)).map((row) => row.post);
    for (const post of [fromYoung.id, fromStranger.id, quoted.id]) expect(stored).not.toContain(post);
    // The rules as read back, and the defaults for an account that never changed them.
    expect(ActivitySettings.parse(await (await ada.b.fetch("/api/activity/settings")).json())).toEqual(ACTIVITY_DEFAULTS);
    expect(ActivitySettings.parse(await (await young.b.fetch("/api/activity/settings")).json())).toEqual(ACTIVITY_DEFAULTS);
    for (const bad of [{ ...ACTIVITY_DEFAULTS, replies: "friends" }, { ...ACTIVITY_DEFAULTS, follows: "yes" }, { replies: "everyone" }]) {
      const res = await ada.b.fetch("/api/activity/settings", { method: "PUT", json: bad });
      expect(res.status).toBe(400);
      expect(await h.code(res)).toBe("invalid_request");
    }
  });

  test("a mute writes no new entry and hides the old ones while it stands; an unmute shows them again", async () => {
    const [ada, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const root = await h.post(ada, "a post of ada's");
    const first = await h.post(bob, "a first reply", { replyToId: root.id });
    expect(await h.relate(ada, bob, "mute")).toBe(200);
    expect((await h.page(ada)).items).toEqual([]);
    const second = await h.post(bob, "a second reply", { replyToId: root.id });
    expect(await h.relate(ada, bob, "mute", false)).toBe(200);
    expect(h.summary((await h.page(ada)).items)).toEqual([`reply:${first.id}`]);
    expect((await h.stored(ada.id)).map((row) => row.post)).toEqual([first.id]);
    expect(second.replyTo?.id).toBe(root.id);
  });

  test("a block either way deletes the pair's entries both ways; an entry a mention wrote while the block was made is hidden while it stands, and shown after an unblock", async () => {
    const [ada, bob, cat] = [await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const root = await h.post(ada, "a post of ada's");
    await h.post(bob, "a reply", { replyToId: root.id });
    await h.post(ada, `hello @${bob.handle}`);
    await h.post(cat, `hello @${ada.handle}`);
    await h.post(ada, `hello @${cat.handle}`);
    expect((await h.stored(ada.id)).length).toBe(2);
    // Ada blocks Bob: both of their entries go. Cat blocks Ada: theirs go too.
    expect(await h.relate(ada, bob, "block")).toBe(200);
    expect(await h.relate(cat, ada, "block")).toBe(200);
    expect(await h.stored(ada.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await h.stored(bob.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await h.stored(cat.id)).toEqual([]);

    // 5.6's race: a mention takes no pair lock, so its entry can commit after the block's deletion. The block is written
    // here after the entry, as the migrator, so the entry stays: the list hides it while the block stands.
    const [dan, eve] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const named = await h.post(eve, `hello @${dan.handle}`);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into blocks (blocker_id, blocked_id, created_at) values (${eve.id}::uuid, ${dan.id}::uuid, now())`);
    expect((await h.page(dan)).items).toEqual([]);
    expect((await h.stored(dan.id)).map((row) => row.post)).toEqual([named.id]);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from blocks where blocker_id = ${eve.id}::uuid and blocked_id = ${dan.id}::uuid`);
    expect(h.summary((await h.page(dan)).items)).toEqual([`mention:${named.id}`]);
  });

  test("an unfollow hides the follow's entry, and a follow again writes none: the first one shows again, with its time", async () => {
    const [ada, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    expect(await h.relate(bob, ada, "follow")).toBe(200);
    const [first] = (await h.page(ada)).items;
    expect(first).toMatchObject({ type: "follows", count: 1 });
    expect(await h.relate(bob, ada, "follow", false)).toBe(200);
    expect((await h.page(ada)).items).toEqual([]);
    expect(await h.relate(bob, ada, "follow")).toBe(200);
    const [again] = (await h.page(ada)).items;
    expect(again).toEqual(first);
    expect(await h.stored(ada.id)).toEqual([{ kind: "follow", actor: bob.id, post: null }]);
  });

  test("a withheld reply is hidden and shown again once restored; a removed and a disabled one are hidden; one its author deletes is gone", async () => {
    const [ada, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const root = await h.post(ada, "a post of ada's");
    const [withheld, removed, disabled, deleted] = [
      await h.post(bob, "a reply withheld for a while", { replyToId: root.id }),
      await h.post(bob, "a reply removed", { replyToId: root.id }),
      await h.post(bob, "a reply disabled for an order", { replyToId: root.id }),
      await h.post(bob, "a reply its author deletes", { replyToId: root.id }),
    ];
    await decideForTest(h.apiDb, withheld.id, "withheld");
    await decideForTest(h.apiDb, removed.id, "removed");
    // An order's disabling, as the migrator writes the post's state (posts_guard lets only it).
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'disabled', moderation_level = 'disabled' where id = ${disabled.id}::uuid`);
    expect((await bob.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${deleted.id}`, { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(204);
    expect((await h.page(ada)).items).toEqual([]);
    // The deleted reply's entry went with it; the others stay, hidden.
    expect((await h.stored(ada.id)).map((row) => row.post)).toEqual([withheld.id, removed.id, disabled.id]);
    await decideForTest(h.apiDb, withheld.id, "visible");
    expect(h.summary((await h.page(ada)).items)).toEqual([`reply:${withheld.id}`]);
  });

  test("a suspended actor's earlier entries stay, with no label, and its new acts are refused; a suspended recipient still receives entries and reads its list", async () => {
    const [ada, bob, cat] = [await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const root = await h.post(ada, "a post of ada's");
    const earlier = await h.post(bob, "a reply before the suspension", { replyToId: root.id });
    await suspendRowForTest(h.migrateDb, bob.id);
    try {
      expect(h.summary((await h.page(ada)).items)).toEqual([`reply:${earlier.id}`]);
      const refused = await bob.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body: "a reply while suspended", replyToId: root.id } });
      expect(refused.status).toBe(403);
      expect(await h.code(refused)).toBe("account_suspended");
      expect((await bob.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${ada.handle}/follow`, { method: "POST" })).status).toBe(403);
      expect((await h.stored(ada.id)).length).toBe(1);
    } finally {
      await liftRowForTest(h.migrateDb, bob.id);
    }
    await suspendRowForTest(h.migrateDb, ada.id);
    try {
      const later = await h.post(cat, "a reply to a suspended account", { replyToId: root.id });
      expect(h.summary((await h.page(ada)).items)).toEqual([`reply:${later.id}`, `reply:${earlier.id}`]);
    } finally {
      await liftRowForTest(h.migrateDb, ada.id);
    }
  });

  test("follows are grouped by UTC day, at the newest follow, with the count and the three newest; a page boundary inside a day leaves one group", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp();
    const followers = [await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const replier = await signUp();
    for (const f of followers) expect(await h.relate(f, ada, "follow")).toBe(200);
    const root = await h.post(ada, "a post of ada's");
    const reply = await h.post(replier, "a reply", { replyToId: root.id });
    // Dated as the migrator, which activity_items_insert lets write a time: four follows and the reply on one UTC day three
    // days ago, the reply between them, and one follow the day before.
    const d1 = new Date(Date.now() - 3 * DAY_MS).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const d0 = new Date(Date.now() - 4 * DAY_MS).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const times: [string, string][] = [
      [followers[0]!.id, `${d1}T08:00:00.000001Z`],
      [followers[1]!.id, `${d1}T09:00:00.000002Z`],
      [followers[2]!.id, `${d1}T12:00:00.000003Z`],
      [followers[3]!.id, `${d1}T23:59:59.999999Z`],
      [followers[4]!.id, `${d0}T09:00:00.000000Z`],
    ];
    for (const [actor, at] of times) await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update activity_items set created_at = ${at}::timestamptz where recipient_id = ${ada.id}::uuid and actor_id = ${actor}::uuid`);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update activity_items set created_at = ${`${d1}T11:00:00.000000Z`}::timestamptz where post_id = ${reply.id}::uuid`);
    const group = `follows:${d1}:4:${[followers[3], followers[2], followers[1]].map((f) => f!.handle).join(",")}`;
    const expected = [group, `reply:${reply.id}`, `follows:${d0}:1:${followers[4]!.handle}`];
    expect(h.summary(await h.all(ada))).toEqual(expected);
    const [first] = (await h.page(ada)).items;
    expect(first).toMatchObject({ key: `f:${d1}`, at: `${d1}T23:59:59.999999Z`, count: 4 });
    // A page of one: the group, then the reply that falls between its follows, then the other day; the group once.
    const onePerPage = { ...h.activity.deps, pageSize: 1 };
    const pages: string[] = [];
    let cursor: string | undefined;
    for (let n = 0; n < 5; n++) {
      const got = await activityPage(onePerPage, ada.id, { tab: "all", cursor });
      pages.push(...h.summary(got.items));
      if (got.nextCursor === null) break;
      cursor = got.nextCursor;
    }
    expect(pages).toEqual(expected);
  });

  test("the seen marker moves only forward and never past the clock; `new` reads the stored marker; the newer count counts as the list draws and stops at 21", async () => {
    const [ada, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const root = await h.post(ada, "a post of ada's");
    const first = await h.post(bob, "a first reply", { replyToId: root.id });
    const second = await h.post(bob, "a second reply", { replyToId: root.id });
    const opened = await h.page(ada);
    expect(opened.seenAt).toBeNull();
    expect(opened.items.map((entry) => entry.new)).toEqual([true, true]);
    const [atSecond, atFirst] = opened.items.map((entry) => entry.at) as [string, string];
    expect(h.summary(opened.items)).toEqual([`reply:${second.id}`, `reply:${first.id}`]);
    const seen = (at: string) => ada.b.fetch("/api/activity/seen", { json: { at } });
    expect((await seen(atFirst)).status).toBe(204);
    const afterFirst = await h.page(ada);
    expect(afterFirst.seenAt).toBe(atFirst);
    expect(afterFirst.items.map((entry) => entry.new)).toEqual([true, false]);
    // An older marker, as another device sends it, changes nothing.
    expect((await seen("2001-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z")).status).toBe(204);
    expect((await h.page(ada)).seenAt).toBe(atFirst);
    // A marker ahead of the server's clock stops at the clock.
    expect((await seen("2100-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z")).status).toBe(204);
    const ahead = await h.page(ada);
    expect(ahead.seenAt! > atSecond && ahead.seenAt! < "2100").toBe(true);
    expect(ahead.items.map((entry) => entry.new)).toEqual([false, false]);
    // Only an ActivityTime: a time to the millisecond is not one.
    for (const at of ["2026-10-28T10:00:00.000Z", "yesterday"]) expect((await seen(at)).status).toBe(400);

    expect(await newer(ada)).toBe(2);
    expect(await newer(ada, `?since=${encodeURIComponent(atSecond)}`)).toBe(0);
    expect(await newer(ada, `?since=${encodeURIComponent(atFirst)}`)).toBe(1);
    for (let n = 0; n < ACTIVITY_NEWER_CAP + 1; n++) await h.post(bob, `reply ${n}`, { replyToId: root.id });
    expect(await newer(ada, `?since=${encodeURIComponent(atSecond)}`)).toBe(ACTIVITY_NEWER_CAP);
    expect(await newer(ada, "?tab=conversations")).toBe(ACTIVITY_NEWER_CAP);
    for (const query of ["?since=2026-10-28T10:00:00Z", "?tab=likes"]) expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/activity/newer${query}`)).status).toBe(400);
    // A page's cursor is only what the list wrote.
    for (const query of ["?cursor=nonsense", "?tab=likes"]) {
      const res = await ada.b.fetch(`/api/activity${query}`);
      expect(res.status, query).toBe(400);
      expect(await h.code(res)).toBe("invalid_request");
    }
    // Signed out, nothing.
    expect((await h.app.request("/api/activity")).status).toBe(401);
  });

  leavesNoModerationRows(() => h.apiDb);

  test("this file left no row behind: the accounts it made go with what hangs on them, and 2d's tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await h.removeMade();
    expect(await h.counts()).toEqual(h.before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/http-hide-counts.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { CountsResponse, EngagementResponse, PostView, ThreadResponse, TimelinePage, type PostCounts } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { activityHarness, type ActivityHarness, type Member } from "./activity-harness";
import { liftRowForTest, suspendRowForTest } from "./moderation-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

/**
 * The author's hidden counts (2d design, decision 26, sections 9.2, 9.3 and 10.6; section 12.3): set in the composer or by
 * PATCH /api/posts/:id/counts, after which everyone but the author reads the post's likes and reposts as null in every
 * answer that carries counts, the answer to their own like and unlike included; replies and quotes stay numbers. The
 * author keeps the numbers. Refused for a post that is not the caller's, deleted or disabled; a suspended author may hide
 * them and is refused showing them.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: hidden counts over HTTP", () => {
  let h: ActivityHarness;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    h = await activityHarness();
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await h?.close();
  }, 120_000);

  const signUp = () => h.signUp();
  const hide = (m: Member, postId: string, hidden: boolean) => m.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${postId}/counts`, { method: "PATCH", json: { hidden } });
  const view = async (postId: string, reader?: Member) => PostView.parse(await (reader ? await reader.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${postId}`) : await h.app.request(`/api/posts/${postId}`)).json());
  const engage = async (m: Member, postId: string, kind: "like" | "repost", on: boolean) => {
    const res = await m.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${postId}/${kind}`, { method: on ? "POST" : "DELETE" });
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return EngagementResponse.parse(await res.json());
  };
  const hidden = (counts: Omit<PostCounts, "likes" | "reposts">): PostCounts => ({ likes: null, reposts: null, ...counts });

  test("hidden in the composer: the author reads the numbers, everyone else null likes and reposts in every view, the quoted embed and the answer to their own like and unlike; replies and quotes stay numbers", async () => {
    const [ada, bob, cat] = [await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const post = await h.post(ada, "a post whose counts are hidden", { hideCounts: true });
    expect(post).toMatchObject({ countsHidden: true, counts: { likes: 0, reposts: 0, replies: 0, quotes: 0 } });
    // Bob likes and reposts it: his own answers carry null, never the number his act moved.
    expect((await engage(bob, post.id, "like", true)).counts).toEqual(hidden({ replies: 0, quotes: 0 }));
    expect((await engage(bob, post.id, "repost", true)).counts).toEqual(hidden({ replies: 0, quotes: 0 }));
    expect((await engage(cat, post.id, "like", true)).counts.likes).toBeNull();
    await h.post(cat, "a reply", { replyToId: post.id });
    const quote = await h.post(cat, "a quote", { quoteOfId: post.id });
    const expectedHidden = hidden({ replies: 1, quotes: 1 });
    for (const reader of [bob, cat, undefined]) {
      const got = await view(post.id, reader);
      expect(got.counts, reader?.handle ?? "signed out").toEqual(expectedHidden);
      expect(got.countsHidden).toBe(true);
    }
    // The author's numbers, in the view and in the author's own engagement answer.
    expect((await view(post.id, ada)).counts).toEqual({ likes: 2, reposts: 1, replies: 1, quotes: 1 });
    expect((await engage(ada, post.id, "like", true)).counts).toEqual({ likes: 3, reposts: 1, replies: 1, quotes: 1 });
    // The quoted embed follows the same rule, for the quote's author and for a reader of it.
    expect(((await view(quote.id, cat)).quoteOf as PostView).counts).toEqual({ ...expectedHidden, likes: null });
    expect(((await view(quote.id, ada)).quoteOf as PostView).counts).toMatchObject({ likes: 3, reposts: 1 });
    // The thread, the profile's posts, Latest and the reposter's timeline read the same.
    const thread = ThreadResponse.parse(await (await bob.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${post.id}/thread`)).json());
    expect(thread.post.counts).toEqual(expectedHidden);
    const tab = TimelinePage.parse(await (await bob.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${ada.handle}/posts`)).json());
    expect(tab.items.find((item) => item.post.id === post.id)?.post.counts).toEqual(expectedHidden);
    const reposted = TimelinePage.parse(await (await bob.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${bob.handle}/posts`)).json());
    expect(reposted.items.find((item) => item.kind === "repost" && item.post.id === post.id)?.post.counts).toEqual(expectedHidden);
    // Unliking tells nothing either.
    expect((await engage(bob, post.id, "like", false)).counts).toEqual(hidden({ replies: 1, quotes: 1 }));
    expect((await view(post.id, ada)).counts.likes).toBe(2);
  });

  test("the route hides and shows them on the author's own post, a withheld or removed one included; another's post, a deleted one and a disabled one are not found; a body that is not { hidden } is refused", async () => {
    const [ada, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const post = await h.post(ada, "counts shown, then hidden");
    expect(post.countsHidden).toBe(false);
    expect((await engage(bob, post.id, "like", true)).counts.likes).toBe(1);
    const res = await hide(ada, post.id, true);
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(CountsResponse.parse(await res.json())).toEqual({ countsHidden: true });
    expect((await view(post.id, bob)).counts.likes).toBeNull();
    expect(CountsResponse.parse(await (await hide(ada, post.id, false)).json())).toEqual({ countsHidden: false });
    expect((await view(post.id, bob)).counts.likes).toBe(1);
    // Another account's post, as for a post that does not exist.
    const refused = await hide(bob, post.id, true);
    expect(refused.status).toBe(404);
    expect(await h.code(refused)).toBe("not_found");
    // A withheld post, which its author still sees, changes; a disabled one and a deleted one are not found.
    const [withheld, disabled, deleted] = [await h.post(ada, "withheld"), await h.post(ada, "disabled"), await h.post(ada, "deleted")];
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'withheld', moderation_level = 'withheld' where id = ${withheld.id}::uuid`);
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'disabled', moderation_level = 'disabled' where id = ${disabled.id}::uuid`);
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${deleted.id}`, { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(204);
    expect((await hide(ada, withheld.id, true)).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await hide(ada, disabled.id, true)).status).toBe(404);
    expect((await hide(ada, deleted.id, true)).status).toBe(404);
    const [row] = await h.migrateDb.execute<{ hidden: boolean }>(sql`select hide_counts as hidden from posts where id = ${withheld.id}::uuid`);
    expect(row!.hidden).toBe(true);
    for (const body of [{}, { hidden: "yes" }]) expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${post.id}/counts`, { method: "PATCH", json: body })).status).toBe(400);
    // Signed out, nothing.
    expect((await h.app.request(`/api/posts/${post.id}/counts`, { method: "PATCH" })).status).toBe(401);
  });

  test("a suspended author may hide a post's counts, which only reduces what others see, and is refused showing them", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp();
    const post = await h.post(ada, "a post of a suspended author");
    await suspendRowForTest(h.migrateDb, ada.id);
    try {
      expect((await hide(ada, post.id, true)).status).toBe(200);
      const refused = await hide(ada, post.id, false);
      expect(refused.status).toBe(403);
      expect(await h.code(refused)).toBe("account_suspended");
    } finally {
      await liftRowForTest(h.migrateDb, ada.id);
    }
    expect((await view(post.id)).countsHidden).toBe(true);
    expect((await hide(ada, post.id, false)).status).toBe(200);
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the accounts it made go with what hangs on them, and 2d's tables hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await h.removeMade();
    expect(await h.counts()).toEqual(h.before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/mentions.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { MENTION_STORE_MAX, PostView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { profiles, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { createSocialRepo } from "../../src/social/repo";
import { activityHarness, type ActivityHarness, type Member } from "./activity-harness";
import { gate, hex64, retireHandleForTest, untilBlocked } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";

// Every test signs accounts up over HTTP, and one holds a purge open while a post waits for its lock.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

/**
 * Mentions as data (2d design, sections 4.2 to 4.4; section 12.3): a handle typed in a post is stored with the account that
 * holds it at that moment and links, for each reader, only while that account still holds the handle and no block stands
 * between the reader and it; it is stored whatever blocks exist, and notifies under 5.2's rules. An imported post's text
 * is never read; a deletion, an erasure and a purge take the rows with them.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: mentions as data", () => {
  let h: ActivityHarness;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    h = await activityHarness();
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await h?.close();
  }, 120_000);

  const signUp = () => h.signUp();
  /** A post's stored mentions as the migrator reads them: the account, the handle as written and the place. */
  const stored = async (postId: string) =>
    (
      await h.migrateDb.execute<{ account_id: string; handle: string; position: number }>(
        sql`select account_id, handle, position from post_mentions where post_id = ${postId}::uuid order by position`,
      )
    ).map((row) => ({ account: row.account_id, handle: row.handle, position: row.position }));
  /** The post as `reader` reads it (signed out without one), or its status when it is not shown. */
  const read = async (postId: string, reader?: Member): Promise<PostView | number> => {
    const res = reader ? await reader.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${postId}`) : await h.app.request(`/api/posts/${postId}`);
    return res.status === 200 ? PostView.parse(await res.json()) : res.status;
  };
  const mentionsFor = async (postId: string, reader?: Member) => {
    const view = await read(postId, reader);
    if (typeof view === "number") throw new Error(`the post answered ${view}`);
    return view.mentions;
  };
  /** A live profile that holds exactly this handle, as only a test makes one. */
  const profileWithHandle = async (handle: string): Promise<string> => {
    const id = randomUUID();
    await (h.apiDb as Db).insert(profiles).values({ id, handle, displayName: `Profile ${handle}` });
    h.made.push(id);
    return id;
  };

  test("a stored mention links while its account holds the handle as written; after a rename and after a retirement it is plain text, and the entry already written stays", async () => {
    const [ada, bob, cat] = [await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const post = await h.post(ada, `thanks @${bob.handle} and @${cat.handle}`);
    expect(post.mentions).toEqual([bob.handle, cat.handle]);
    expect(await stored(post.id)).toEqual([
      { account: bob.id, handle: bob.handle, position: 0 },
      { account: cat.id, handle: cat.handle, position: 1 },
    ]);
    // Signed out, every live mention whose handle is unchanged.
    expect(await mentionsFor(post.id)).toEqual([bob.handle, cat.handle]);
    const renamed = `r${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`;
    expect(await createSocialRepo(h.apiDb).changeHandle(bob.id, renamed, new Date())).toEqual({ ok: true, from: bob.handle });
    await retireHandleForTest(h.migrateDb, cat.id);
    for (const reader of [undefined, ada, bob, cat]) expect(await mentionsFor(post.id, reader)).toEqual([]);
    // Nothing stored changed: the account by id and the handle as written; the entries stay.
    expect(await stored(post.id)).toEqual([
      { account: bob.id, handle: bob.handle, position: 0 },
      { account: cat.id, handle: cat.handle, position: 1 },
    ]);
    expect(await h.stored(bob.id)).toEqual([{ kind: "mention", actor: ada.id, post: post.id }]);
    expect(await h.stored(cat.id)).toEqual([{ kind: "mention", actor: ada.id, post: post.id }]);
    // The post's text is never rewritten.
    expect((await read(post.id, ada)) as PostView).toMatchObject({ body: `thanks @${bob.handle} and @${cat.handle}` });
  });

  test("a handle nobody held when the post was written stores nothing, and links nothing once an account claims it", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp();
    const free = `f${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`;
    const post = await h.post(ada, `hello @${free}`);
    expect(post.mentions).toEqual([]);
    expect(await stored(post.id)).toEqual([]);
    const claimant = await profileWithHandle(free);
    expect(await mentionsFor(post.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await h.stored(claimant)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a mention of an account that blocks the author, or that the author blocks, is stored and links for a third reader, is plain text for the author and writes no entry; a reader who blocks the mentioned account reads it plain", async () => {
    const [ada, bob, cat, reader] = [await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp(), await signUp()];
    expect(await h.relate(bob, ada, "block")).toBe(200);
    expect(await h.relate(ada, cat, "block")).toBe(200);
    const post = await h.post(ada, `@${bob.handle} and @${cat.handle}`);
    expect((await stored(post.id)).map((row) => row.account)).toEqual([bob.id, cat.id]);
    expect(await mentionsFor(post.id, reader)).toEqual([bob.handle, cat.handle]);
    expect(await mentionsFor(post.id)).toEqual([bob.handle, cat.handle]);
    // The author reads both plain; the two blocked accounts are not shown the post at all.
    expect(post.mentions).toEqual([]);
    expect(await mentionsFor(post.id, ada)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await read(post.id, bob)).toBe(404);
    expect(await read(post.id, cat)).toBe(404);
    expect(await h.stored(bob.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await h.stored(cat.id)).toEqual([]);
    // A reader who blocks one of them reads that one plain and the other as a link.
    expect(await h.relate(reader, cat, "block")).toBe(200);
    expect(await mentionsFor(post.id, reader)).toEqual([bob.handle]);
  });

  test("the first twenty live handles are stored, in text order, each once whatever its case; the rest stay plain text", async () => {
    const ada = await signUp();
    const named: { id: string; handle: string }[] = [];
    for (let n = 0; n < MENTION_STORE_MAX + 2; n++) {
      const profile = await newProfile(h.apiDb);
      h.made.push(profile.id);
      named.push(profile);
    }
    const body = `@${named[0]!.handle.toUpperCase()} ${named.map((p) => `@${p.handle}`).join(" ")}`;
    const post = await h.post(ada, body);
    const kept = named.slice(0, MENTION_STORE_MAX);
    expect(await stored(post.id)).toEqual(kept.map((p, position) => ({ account: p.id, handle: p.handle, position })));
    expect(post.mentions).toEqual(kept.map((p) => p.handle));
    // The last two are neither stored nor told.
    for (const p of named.slice(MENTION_STORE_MAX)) expect(await h.stored(p.id)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("an imported post (3b's publishImportedBatch) stores no mention and tells no one, whatever handles its text holds", async () => {
    const [ada, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const jobId = randomUUID();
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into import_jobs (id, owner_id, source, status, declared_bytes) values (${jobId}::uuid, ${ada.id}::uuid, 'x', 'publishing', 1000)`);
    const postId = randomUUID();
    const result = await createSocialRepo(h.apiDb).publishImportedBatch(
      { id: jobId, ownerId: ada.id, source: "x", cursor: 0 },
      { lines: 1, posts: [{ id: postId, parentId: null, body: `an imported post that names @${bob.handle}`, originalCreatedAt: "2019-03-03T12:00:00Z", shortened: false, key: hex64(), images: [] }] },
      new Date(),
      async () => undefined,
    );
    expect(result).toEqual({ written: true, posts: [{ id: postId, images: false }] });
    expect(await stored(postId)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await h.stored(bob.id)).toEqual([]);
    const view = (await read(postId, bob)) as PostView;
    expect(view.imported).toMatchObject({ source: "x" });
    expect(view.mentions).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a deletion by the author and an erasure remove a post's mentions; the deletion its entries too", async () => {
    const [ada, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const [deleted, erased] = [await h.post(ada, `@${bob.handle} one`), await h.post(ada, `@${bob.handle} two`)];
    expect((await stored(deleted.id)).length).toBe(1);
    expect((await h.stored(bob.id)).length).toBe(2);
    expect((await ada.b.fetch(`/api/posts/${deleted.id}`, { method: "DELETE" })).status).toBe(204);
    expect(await stored(deleted.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await h.stored(bob.id)).toEqual([{ kind: "mention", actor: ada.id, post: erased.id }]);
    // An erasure, as 3c's R4 redaction leaves a post: the body blanked and the post removed (post_mentions_erase).
    await h.migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set erased_at = now(), body = '', state = 'removed', moderation_level = 'removed' where id = ${erased.id}::uuid`);
    expect(await stored(erased.id)).toEqual([]);
    expect((await h.page(bob)).items).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("a mentioned account purged while the post waits for its row leaves no mention and no entry: the post's lookup reads the row again after the purge and drops it", async () => {
    const [ada, bob] = [await signUp(), await signUp()];
    const target = await newProfile(h.apiDb);
    h.made.push(target.id);
    const held = gate();
    const repo = createSocialRepo(h.apiDb);
    // The purge holds the account's row FOR UPDATE until the test lets it commit.
    const purging = repo.purgeProfile(target.id, new Date(), async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '60s'`);
      await held.opened;
    });
    let posting: Promise<PostView> | null = null;
    try {
      // Bob's post names the account; its lookup waits at the row the purge holds.
      posting = h.post(bob, `hello @${target.handle} and @${ada.handle}`);
      await untilBlocked(h.apiDb, "and deleted_at is null order by id for key share");
    } finally {
      held.open();
    }
    await purging;
    const post = await posting!;
```
