import type { MeProfile } from "@korbat/contracts";
import pino from "pino";
import type { AuthConfig, AuthDeps, ProfileStore, RequestContext } from "../../src/auth/context";
import { decrypt, parseVersionedKey, randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { signIn } from "../../src/auth/flows/signin";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { createLockout } from "../../src/auth/lockout";
import { hashPassword } from "../../src/auth/passwords";
import type { AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { createSessions } from "../../src/auth/sessions";
import { currentStep, hotp } from "../../src/auth/totp";
import { devProvider } from "../../src/auth/verify/dev";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { fakeClock } from "./auth-fixtures";

/**
 * Handles unique per store, like the real public.profiles index. A new profile has never changed its handle, holds no
 * badge and shows its posts in Explore, and (2d) shows no link preview, as the columns' defaults have it.
 */
export function memoryProfiles(): ProfileStore {
  const byHandle = new Map<string, MeProfile>();
  const byId = new Map<string, MeProfile>();
  return {
    async create({ id, handle, displayName }) {
      if (byHandle.has(handle) || byId.has(id)) return { ok: false, reason: "handle_taken" };
      const profile = { id, handle, displayName, handleChangedAt: null, verified: false, showInExplore: true, sharePreviews: false };
      byHandle.set(handle, profile);
      byId.set(id, profile);
      return { ok: true, profile: { id, handle, displayName } };
    },
    async find(id) {
      return byId.get(id) ?? null;
    },
    async setVerified(id, at) {
      const profile = byId.get(id);
      if (profile) profile.verified = at !== null;
      return true;
    },
    // No account of these suites is suspended: the real store and its predicate are http-badge.test.ts's.
    async suspended() {
      return false;
    },
  };
}

export const TEST_TERMS = "draft-test";
export const CHROME_WINDOWS = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/139.0.0.0 Safari/537.36";

/**
 * Real auth repository (Postgres) with an in-memory key-value store, mailer and profile store, a fake
 * clock shared by all of them, Turnstile that fails only for the token "fail", and a breach checker
 * that flags passwords containing "breached". A suite whose profiles live in the public schema (the
 * deletion flow compares the typed handle with the profile's) passes the real profile store instead. The staff
 * console is off unless a suite names its origin and relying party ID, as the staff suites do (3a design, section 12).
 */
export function flowHarness(repo: AuthRepo, options: { profiles?: ProfileStore; console?: { origin: string; rpId: string } } = {}) {
  const clock = fakeClock();
  const kv = new MemoryKv(clock.ms);
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  const config: AuthConfig = {
    appOrigin: "http://localhost:8081",
    allowedOrigins: ["http://localhost:8081"],
    authHmacKey: Buffer.alloc(32, 3),
    ipHashKey: Buffer.alloc(32, 4),
    totpKey: parseVersionedKey(`v1:${Buffer.alloc(32, 5).toString("base64")}`),
    totpPreviousKeys: [],
    notifierKey: parseVersionedKey(`v1:${Buffer.alloc(32, 6).toString("base64")}`),
    notifierPreviousKeys: [],
    termsVersion: TEST_TERMS,
    trustProxy: "none",
    verifyProvider: "dev",
    webauthn: { rpId: "localhost", rpName: "korbat", origins: ["http://localhost:8081"] },
    console: options.console ?? null,
    homeState: null,
    contactPoint: null,
    // 3f Task 5: the report hold, on as by default.
    reportHold: true,
    // 3d Task 5: no keeper's address, so the head's daily mail is not sent from a flow.
    keeperMail: null,
  };
  const deps: AuthDeps = {
    repo,
    kv,
    mailer,
    config,
    now: clock.now,
    sessions: createSessions({ repo, kv, now: clock.now }),
    lockout: createLockout({ repo, kv, now: clock.now }),
    turnstile: { verify: async (token) => token !== "fail" },
    breachChecker: { isBreached: async (password) => password.includes("breached") },
    profiles: options.profiles ?? memoryProfiles(),
    verify: devProvider(),
    log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
  };
  const ctx: RequestContext = { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: CHROME_WINDOWS };
  return { deps, clock, kv, mailer, ctx };
}

export type FlowHarness = ReturnType<typeof flowHarness>;

export const newTestEmail = (prefix = "flow") => `${prefix}-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
export const newTestDevice = () => ({ deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" as const });
export const wrongCode = (code: string) => String((Number(code) + 1) % 1_000_000).padStart(6, "0");

/** An onboarded account, optionally with a password, signed in on one web device. */
export async function onboardedUser(h: FlowHarness, repo: AuthRepo, options: { password?: string } = {}) {
  const email = newTestEmail("account");
  const created = await repo.createUser({ email, termsVersion: TEST_TERMS, now: new Date() });
  await repo.markOnboarded(created.id, new Date());
  if (options.password) await repo.setPasswordHash(created.id, await hashPassword(options.password), new Date());
  const user = (await repo.findUserById(created.id))!;
  const device = newTestDevice();
  const signed = await signIn(h.deps, user, device, h.ctx, { alertNewDevice: false, factors: { email: h.clock.ms() }, method: "email" });
  return { email, user, device, session: signed.issued.session, token: signed.issued.token };
}

export type OnboardedUser = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof onboardedUser>>;

/** The TOTP code for a user's stored secret at the harness clock. */
export async function currentTotpCode(h: FlowHarness, repo: AuthRepo, userId: string): Promise<string> {
  const user = (await repo.findUserById(userId))!;
  const secret = new Uint8Array(decrypt(user.totpSecretEnc!, [h.deps.config.totpKey]));
  return hotp(secret, currentStep(h.clock.ms()));
}

  test("an account's own reports are in its export as its list shows them: an item decided but not released shows no outcome; released, it reads the list's words under the link the report named; a re-examination is listed; a report on the anonymous path, another person's report and a record that was erased are not", async () => {

    const explanation = `my own words ${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`;
    const first = await sent(report([postTarget(postId), accountTarget(subject.handle)], { ruleId: "R3", explanation }), reporter.session);
    const second = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(quoting)], { turnstileToken: undefined, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" }), reporter.session);
    // On the path for child sexual abuse material korbat records no sender, the account included: it is in nobody's export.
    const elsewhere = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const anonymous = await sent(notices.csam([postTarget(elsewhere)], { turnstileToken: undefined }), reporter.session);
    // Someone else reports the same post, with words of their own.
    const theirWords = `their words ${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`;
    const theirs = await sent(report([postTarget(postId)], { ruleId: "R3", explanation: theirWords }), other.session);

    const waiting = { reexamines: false, outcome: null, outcomeText: null, reexaminationOpen: null };
    const undecided = (await exportOf(reporter.id)).json.moderation;
    expect(undecided.decisions).toEqual([]);
    expect(undecided.reports).toEqual([
      { ref: second.ref, receivedAt: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]{12}Z$/), ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD", explanation: "It is a threat under section 241.", items: [{ position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${quoting}`, ...waiting }] },
      {
        ref: first.ref,
        receivedAt: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]{12}Z$/),
        ground: "rule",
        ruleId: "R3",
        category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC",
        explanation,
        items: [
          { position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, ...waiting },
          { position: 2, link: `${origin}/u/${subject.handle}`, ...waiting },
        ],
      },
    ]);

    // Decided, and still silent: an export tells nothing before the daily release, as the list and the mail tell nothing.
    await decided(moderator, first.items[0]!.case_id!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", actions: [act("remove")] });
    await decided(moderator, first.items[1]!.case_id!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    await decided(moderator, second.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "not_evident" });
    expect((await exportOf(reporter.id)).json.moderation.reports).toEqual(undecided.reports);
    // The account changes its handle after the report: the export keeps the handle the report named.
    const renamed = `r_${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`;
    await w.apiDb.execute(sql`update profiles set handle = ${renamed} where id = ${subject.id}::uuid`);
    await release();

    const released = await exportOf(reporter.id);
    const rule = getRule("R3")!;
    expect(released.json.moderation.reports.map((entry) => entry.items)).toEqual([
      [{ position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${quoting}`, reexamines: false, outcome: "not_evident", outcomeText: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_evident}. ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`, reexaminationOpen: true }],
      [
        { position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, reexamines: false, outcome: "restricted_rule", outcomeText: `access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R3 (${rule.title}).`, reexaminationOpen: false },
        { position: 2, link: `${origin}/u/${subject.handle}`, reexamines: false, outcome: "no_violation", outcomeText: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}. ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`, reexaminationOpen: true },
      ],
    ]);
    // Item for item what the account's list of reports shows, in its order and in its words.
    const list = await reporterList(w.deps, reporter.id);
    expect(released.json.moderation.reports.map((entry) => [entry.ref, entry.receivedAt])).toEqual(list.reports.map((row) => [row.ref, row.receivedAt]));
    expect(released.json.moderation.reports.map((entry) => entry.items)).toEqual(
      list.reports.map((row) => row.items.map((item) => ({ position: item.position, link: item.link, reexamines: item.reexamines, outcome: item.outcome, outcomeText: itemOutcomeWords(item), reexaminationOpen: item.reexamination?.open ?? false }))),
    );

    // A re-examination of the account's item: the item's one request is spent, and the new item waits at its place.
    const asked = `asked again ${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`;
    await reexamineOwnItem(w.deps, reporter.id, list.reports[1]!.items[1]!.id, { statement: asked });
    await w.moderation.settle();
    expect((await exportOf(reporter.id)).json.moderation.reports[1]!.items).toEqual([
      { position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, reexamines: false, outcome: "restricted_rule", outcomeText: `access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R3 (${rule.title}).`, reexaminationOpen: false },
      { position: 2, link: `${origin}/u/${subject.handle}`, reexamines: false, outcome: "no_violation", outcomeText: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}. ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`, reexaminationOpen: false },
      { position: 2, link: `${origin}/u/${subject.handle}`, reexamines: true, ...{ outcome: null, outcomeText: null, reexaminationOpen: null } },
    ]);

    // Nothing of anyone else's report, of the anonymous one, of the subject's later handle, or of the staff.
    const mine = await exportOf(reporter.id);
    const secrets = { theirRef: theirs.ref, theirWords, otherId: other.id, otherHandle: other.handle, anonymousRef: anonymous.ref, anonymousToken: anonymous.token!, renamed, moderatorId: moderator.id, moderatorHandle: moderator.handle };
    for (const [what, secret] of Object.entries(secrets)) expect(mine.text.includes(secret), what).toBe(false);
    expect([...namesIn(mine.json.moderation.reports)].filter((name) => /reporter|notifier|contact|sender|staff|decidedBy|token|hash|caseId|^id$/i.test(name))).toEqual([]);
    // 3e (W.8): the account's own count of rule reports, by the UTC day it sent them: the report under a rule counts, the
    // notice of illegality and the anonymous report do not, and nothing it sent was marked.
    const sentOn = undecided.reports[1]!.receivedAt.slice(0, 10);
    expect(mine.json.moderation.reporting).toEqual({ frameDays: STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays, days: [{ day: sentOn, reports: 1 }], marks: [], markedReports: 0 });
    // The other reporter's export holds their own report and words, and none of this account's.
    const others = await exportOf(other.id);
    expect(others.json.moderation.reports).toMatchObject([{ ref: theirs.ref, ground: "rule", ruleId: "R3", explanation: theirWords, items: [{ position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, outcome: "restricted_rule" }] }]);
    expect(others.text.includes(explanation)).toBe(false);
    // The author of the reported post reads the decision in theirs, and no report.
    const authors = (await exportOf(author.id)).json.moderation;
    expect(authors.reports).toEqual([]);
    expect(authors.decisions).toMatchObject([{ postId, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ruleId: "R3" }]);

    // A link that named nothing was answered automatically. Once korbat has erased that report's record, 30 days after
    // its outcome was shown, the record names no sender any more and the report has left the export, as it left the list.
    const nothing = await sent(report([linkTarget(`${origin}/post/${randomUUID()}`)]), reporter.session);
    await release();
    expect((await exportOf(reporter.id)).json.moderation.reports[0]).toMatchObject({ ref: nothing.ref, items: [{ position: 1, outcome: "not_available", outcomeText: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_available}.`, reexaminationOpen: false }] });
    const [stored] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from intakes where ref = ${nothing.ref}`);
    await w.migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      await ageIntake(tx, stored!.id, "31 days");
    });
    expect(await eraseIntake(w.apiDb, stored!.id)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const after = await exportOf(reporter.id);
    expect(after.json.moderation.reports.map((entry) => entry.ref)).toEqual([second.ref, first.ref]);
    expect(after.text.includes(nothing.ref)).toBe(false);

    // The suspect item of the anonymous report is answered, so that nothing of this test keeps a post frozen.
    await decided(admin, anonymous.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
  });

  test("a post whose images are sealed is exported with its text and without those images, in the list and in the files, and the decision that sealed them is in the member; once the seal has ended the images are the account's to export again", async () => {
    const author = await w.account();
    const sealedPost = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "text beside the images" });
    const sealedImages = [await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, sealedPost, 0), await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, sealedPost, 1)];
    const plainPost = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "another post" });
    const plainImage = await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, plainPost, 0);
    const notice = await sent(notices.csam([postTarget(sealedPost)]));

    // Reported, and frozen: nothing is hidden yet, and the export lists every image. None of these rows has a file in
    // this test's store, so each image the export tried to write is named under missingMedia.
    const frozen = await exportOf(author.id);
    expect(frozen.json.posts.find((post) => post.id === sealedPost)!.media.map((image) => image.id)).toEqual(sealedImages);
    expect([...frozen.json.missingMedia].sort()).toEqual([...sealedImages, plainImage].sort());
    // 3e (W.8): an account with no standing measure, no reply and no report has empty lists and counts, over the frame of its counts.
    expect(frozen.json.moderation).toEqual({ decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [], standing: [], replies: [], reporting: { frameDays: STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays, days: [], marks: [], markedReports: 0 }, uploads: [], releases: [] });

    expect(sealed.json.posts.find((post) => post.id === plainPost)!.media).toEqual([{ id: plainImage, file: `media/${plainImage}.webp`, altText: "image 1", width: 1200, height: 800 }]);

    for (const image of sealedImages) expect(sealed.text.includes(image), image).toBe(false);

      { id: seal, decidedOn: today(), postId: sealedPost, kind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R2", rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION, measures: [{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }], reversals: [], facts: expect.any(String), reason: expect.any(String), legalReference: null, appeal: null, ...NOT_AUTOMATED },

    expect(sealed.text.includes(notice.ref)).toBe(false);

    // An admin answers without a seal: the seal ends, the images are listed again, and the author is told so.

    const lifted = await exportOf(author.id);
    expect(lifted.json.posts.find((post) => post.id === sealedPost)!.media.map((image) => image.id)).toEqual(sealedImages);
    expect(lifted.json.moderation.decisions.map((entry) => [entry.id, entry.kind, entry.outcome])).toEqual([
      [answer, "final", "no_violation"],
      [seal, "interim", "restricted"],
    ]);
  });

    await w.cleanUp();

} from "@korbat/contracts";

import { newStaffKey } from "./staff-fixtures";

/**
 * Rows for the database tests of the moderation tables (3c design, sections 6.1 and 6.2), written as SQL the way the
 * intake transaction writes them: an insert names only what the API supplies, and the triggers of migrations 0015 and
 * 0016 force the rest. The helpers take a pool or a transaction, so a test chooses the role and whether anything commits.
 * The suites share one database, so a test leaves nothing behind: it runs inside a transaction that is rolled back, or,
 * where a second session must see its rows, it commits them and removes them again with removeFixtures.
 */
export type Runner = Db | DbTx;
export type TargetType = "post" | "account";

export const TC = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC";
export const MINORS = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS";
export const SPEECH = "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH";

/** 32 random bytes as lower-case hex: a salt, a digest's stand-in or a token's hash. */
export const hex64 = () => randomBytes(32).toString("hex");

/** A public reference as the API makes it: N- and ten base32 characters. */
export function newRef(): string {
  const alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ234567";
  return `N-${Array.from(randomBytes(10), (byte) => alphabet[byte % 32]).join("")}`;
}

/** Null as SQL, any other value as a parameter. */
const orNull = (value: string | null | undefined, cast: string): SQL => (value === null || value === undefined ? sql`null` : sql`${value}::${sql.raw(cast)}`);

/** Ids as one uuid[] parameter. */
export const uuids = (ids: readonly string[]): SQL => sql`${`{${ids.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]`;

/**
 * A post row straight in the table: these tests need the row, not the flow and its counters. It is dated a month back.
 * The suites share one database, and others read the public Latest timeline from its newest post down and Explore's
 * 48-hour window: a visible post dated now would stand among theirs, and dozens of them push theirs off the first page.
 */
export async function newPostRow(db: Runner, authorId: string, options: { quoteOfId?: string; replyToId?: string; body?: string; createdAt?: SQL } = {}): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(
    sql`insert into posts (author_id, body, quote_of_id, reply_to_id, created_at)
        values (${authorId}::uuid, ${options.body ?? "a post"}, ${orNull(options.quoteOfId, "uuid")}, ${orNull(options.replyToId, "uuid")}, ${options.createdAt ?? sql`now() - interval '30 days'`})
        returning id`,
  );
  return row!.id;
}

/**
 * A ready image of the account, on the post when one is given. The row is inserted on no post, which is the only way the
 * database takes one, and then attached with one update of post_id, position and alt text, as the media repository's
 * attach does.
 */
export async function newImageRow(db: Runner, ownerId: string, postId: string | null, position = 0): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(
    sql`insert into post_media (owner_id, status, width, height, blurhash) values (${ownerId}::uuid, 'ready', 1200, 800, 'L2Eo_P_3jb_3~qoL') returning id`,
  );
  if (postId) await db.execute(sql`update post_media set post_id = ${postId}::uuid, position = ${position}, alt_text = ${`image ${position + 1}`} where id = ${row!.id}::uuid`);
  return row!.id;
}

export interface IntakeInput {
  kind?: "user" | "finding";
  channel?: "signed_in" | "signed_out" | "staff";
  reporterId?: string | null;
  findingBy?: string | null;
  contactId?: string | null;
  ruleId?: string | null;

  category?: string;

  bonaFide?: boolean;

  ref?: string;
}

/** Inserts an intake with the ground's columns, as step 4.2 of the intake transaction does, and answers its id. */
export async function insertIntake(db: Runner, input: IntakeInput): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
    insert into intakes (kind, ref, lookup_hash, channel, reporter_id, finding_by, contact_id, rule_id, alleges_illegal, csam, category, category_keyword, cited_law, explanation, bona_fide)
    values (${input.kind ?? "user"}::intake_kind, ${input.ref ?? newRef()}, ${orNull(input.lookupHash, "text")}, ${input.channel ?? "signed_in"}::intake_channel,
            ${orNull(input.reporterId, "uuid")}, ${orNull(input.findingBy, "uuid")}, ${orNull(input.contactId, "uuid")}, ${orNull(input.ruleId, "text")},
            ${input.allegesIllegal ?? false}, ${input.csam ?? false}, ${input.category ?? TC}, ${orNull(input.categoryKeyword, "text")},
            ${orNull(input.citedLaw, "text")}, ${orNull(input.explanation, "text")}, ${input.bonaFide ?? false})
    returning id`);
  return row!.id;
}

/** A signed-in report under a korbat rule. */
export const ruleReport = (db: Runner, reporterId: string, ruleId = "R1") => insertIntake(db, { kind: "user", channel: "signed_in", reporterId, ruleId, category: TC });

/** A signed-in notice that the target is illegal, with its explanation and good-faith statement. */
export const illegalNotice = (db: Runner, reporterId: string) =>

/** A notice on the path for child sexual abuse material: signed out, no account, no contact, only the token's hash. */
export const csamNotice = (db: Runner) => insertIntake(db, { kind: "user", channel: "signed_out", csam: true, allegesIllegal: true, category: MINORS, lookupHash: hex64() });

/** A moderator's own finding under a rule. */
export const findingBy = (db: Runner, staffId: string, ruleId: string, category = TC) => insertIntake(db, { kind: "finding", channel: "staff", findingBy: staffId, ruleId, category });

/**
 * The target's open case, opened when there is none: the insert that does nothing on a conflict and the read of the
 * open case, as step 4.3 of the intake transaction runs them.
 */
export async function openCase(db: Runner, targetType: TargetType, targetId: string): Promise<string> {
  await db.execute(sql`insert into cases (target_type, target_id) values (${targetType}::moderation_target, ${targetId}::uuid) on conflict (target_type, target_id) where closed_at is null do nothing`);
  const [row] = await db.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from cases where target_type = ${targetType}::moderation_target and target_id = ${targetId}::uuid and closed_at is null`);
  if (!row) throw new Error("the target has no open case");
  return row.id;
}

/** An item as the database stores it, with the columns these tests read. A raw read hands every time over as PostgreSQL's text. */
export interface ItemRow {

  target_id: string;

/** Inserts one item and answers the row as the attach trigger left it. */
export async function insertItem(db: Runner, input: ItemInput): Promise<ItemRow> {
  const extra = Object.entries(input.extra ?? {});
  const names = extra.map(([name]) => sql.raw(`, ${name}`));
  const values = extra.map(([, value]) => sql`, ${value}`);
  const [row] = await db.execute<ItemRow & Record<string, unknown>>(sql`
    insert ${sql.raw(input.marker ? `/* ${input.marker} */` : "")} into intake_items (intake_id, case_id, target_type, target_id, position, lane, named_handle, outcome, reexamines_item_id${sql.join(names, sql``)})
    values (${input.intakeId}::uuid, ${orNull(input.caseId, "uuid")}, ${input.targetType ?? "post"}::moderation_target, ${input.targetId}::uuid, ${input.position ?? 1}, ${input.lane ?? 2},
            ${orNull(input.namedHandle, "text")}, ${orNull(input.outcome, "item_outcome")}, ${orNull(input.reexaminesItemId, "uuid")}${sql.join(values, sql``)})
    returning *`);
  return row!;
}

/** A case's derived columns. */

}

export async function readCase(db: Runner, id: string): Promise<CaseRow> {

  return row!;
}

/** The items of a case, in the order they attached. */
