```tsx
function StateChip({ post }: { post: PostView }) {
  const [sheetOpen, setSheetOpen] = useState(false);
  const [sheetMounted, setSheetMounted] = useState(false);
  const chipRef = useRef<View>(null);
  if (post.state === "visible") return null;
  const decision = post.moderation;
  const tone: StatusTone = (decision ? decision.interim : post.state === "withheld") ? "review" : "restricted";
  const words = decision ? chipText(decision) : tone === "review" ? CHIP_WORDS.underReview : CHIP_WORDS.removed;
  const openSheet = () => {
    setSheetMounted(true);
    setSheetOpen(true);
  };
  const closed = () => {
    setSheetMounted(false);
    chipRef.current?.focus();
  };
  return (
    <>
      <StatusChip tone={tone} label={words} onPress={decision ? openSheet : undefined} ref={chipRef} />
      {sheetMounted && decision ? <StatusSheet post={post} decisionId={decision.decisionId} title={words} open={sheetOpen} onClose={() => setSheetOpen(false)} onClosed={closed} /> : null}
    </>
  );
}

/**
 * The delete question's two controls, as the card's actions were before the icons: a word in a 44 px target, Delete in
 * the danger fill, Keep plain. While the request is out both are busy.
 */
function Action({ label, tone = "plain", busy, onPress, ref }: { label: string; tone?: "danger" | "plain"; busy?: boolean; onPress: () => void; ref?: Ref<View> }) {
  return (
    <Pressable
      ref={ref}
      accessibilityRole="button"
      aria-busy={busy}
      disabled={busy}
      onPress={onPress}
      {...pressDelay(0)}
      className={cn(
        "min-h-[44px] items-center justify-center rounded-control border px-4",
        tone === "danger" ? "border-danger bg-danger web:hover:bg-danger/90" : "border-line-high bg-surface-1 web:hover:bg-surface-2",
        FOCUS_RING,
      )}
    >
      <Text variant="body-strong" tone={tone === "danger" ? "on-danger" : "high"}>
        {label}
      </Text>
    </Pressable>
  );
}

/**
 * "Delete this post?" in place of the action row (section 6.6), with Delete and Keep. Keep, the safe answer, takes the
 * focus when the question shows; the card gives it back to More when the question is withdrawn.
 */
export function DeleteQuestion({ postId, busy, onDelete, onKeep, keepRef }: { postId: string; busy: boolean; onDelete: () => void; onKeep: () => void; keepRef?: Ref<View> }) {
  return (
    <View role="dialog" aria-labelledby={`delete-${postId}`} className="mt-2 flex-row flex-wrap items-center gap-2 rounded-card border border-line-high bg-surface-1 px-3 py-2 web:forced-colors:border-[color:CanvasText]">
      <Text nativeID={`delete-${postId}`} variant="body-strong" className="mr-auto">
        {UI_WORDS["post.deleteQuestion"]}
      </Text>
      <Action label={UI_WORDS["post.delete"]} tone="danger" busy={busy} onPress={onDelete} />
      <Action ref={keepRef} label="Keep" busy={busy} onPress={onKeep} />
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * The Repost menu's items (decision 12): Repost, or Undo repost once reposted, and Quote, a real link to the post's
 * quote composer as today (`?quote=1`), or to sign in for a reader who is signed out.
 */
export function repostMenuItems(post: PostView, signedIn: boolean, onRepost: () => void): MenuItem[] {
  return [
    { label: post.viewer?.reposted ? UI_WORDS["post.unrepost"] : UI_WORDS["post.repost"], icon: "repost", onSelect: onRepost },
    { label: UI_WORDS["post.quote"], icon: "quote", href: signedIn ? `/post/${post.id}?quote=1` : "/signin" },
  ];
}

const NO_VIEWER = { liked: false, reposted: false, bookmarked: false };

/** How long an action's request may be out before its control says it is busy (section 5.2, pending). */
const PENDING_MS = 400;

/**
 * One post in any list (UI design, section 6.6): an article named by its author line, with one explicit link to the post
 * in its time, and for pointers the whole card body as the open target. Reply, Repost (a menu: Repost or Undo repost, and
 * Quote), Like and Save act at once: the state, the icon and the count change on the press, with its haptic and its
 * motion, the request goes out in its kind's lane, and the server's answer replaces the counts, so they never drift; a
 * refusal puts the old state back, nudges the control and says so in a toast, and a write refused for a suspension shows
 * the standing's sentence under the card (3e, 9.4). A signed-out reader is sent to sign in on the first action. More
 * holds Who sees this, Copy link, Delete for the author and Report for everyone else.
 *
 * Below 768 px the images and the quoted post span the card's inner width, from the avatar's edge to the gutter; wider
 * they keep the content column's indent. `large` is the thread's focused post: its words at 19 / 28, the full date and
 * time, and the stats line above the actions (post/[id].tsx passes it in Task 5).
 *
 * In a feed (section 10) the article says its place, `position` from 1 and `setSize` (-1 while more can load); a list's
 * first two rows pass `priority`, so their images load first (11.2); and a thread's ancestors are `joined`: compact,
 * without a divider, and linked to the post below by a 2 px line-low thread line through their avatars (8.3).
 */
export function PostCard({
  post: initial,
  repostedBy,
  onDeleted,
  large = false,
  position,
  setSize,
  priority = false,
  joined = false,
  onReply,
}: {
  post: PostView;
  repostedBy?: Author;
  onDeleted?: (id: string) => void;
  large?: boolean;
  position?: number;
  setSize?: number;
  priority?: boolean;
  joined?: boolean;
  /** What Reply does instead of opening the thread: the thread's own focused post opens its reply card (Task 6). */
  onReply?: () => void;
}) {
  const { state } = useSession();
  const me = state.status === "signed-in" ? state.me.user.id : null;
  // The reader's own setting (UI decision 15). 2d (decision 26): a count the post's author hid arrives as null, and the
  // buttons and the stats line draw no number for it, as they draw none for a count this setting hides.
  const { hideCounts } = useAppearance();
  const phone = useLayout() === "phone";
  const motion = useMotion();
  const haptic = useHaptics();
  const labelId = useId();
  const [post, setPost] = useState(initial);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  // 3e (design, section 9.4): an action refused account_suspended shows the refusal's sentence from /me, read again after it.
  const [refused, setRefused] = useState(false);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState<Partial<Record<ToggleKind | "delete", boolean>>>({});
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<Partial<Record<ToggleKind, IconButtonFeedback>>>({});
  const [confirmingDelete, setConfirmingDelete] = useState(false);
  const [washed, setWashed] = useState(false);
  // 3b (10.6): Who sees this as the provenance label opens it, mounted while it is open or leaving, as the menus' sheets are.
  const [provenance, setProvenance] = useState({ mounted: false, open: false });
  useEffect(() => setPost(initial), [initial]);
  const moreRef = useRef<View>(null);
  const keepRef = useRef<View>(null);
  const wasConfirming = useRef(false);
  // The action row, More with it, leaves the tree while the question shows, so a keyboard user would drop to the page
  // body: the safe answer takes the focus, and More takes it back when the question is withdrawn.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (confirmingDelete) keepRef.current?.focus();
    else if (wasConfirming.current) moreRef.current?.focus();
    wasConfirming.current = confirmingDelete;
  }, [confirmingDelete]);

  const own = post.author.id === me;
  const viewer = post.viewer ?? NO_VIEWER;
  const openPost = () => router.push(`/post/${post.id}`);
  // Reply (section 6.6): the thread, with its reply card open and focused (?reply=1); signed out, the thread, which says
  // how to sign in to reply.
  const reply = onReply ?? (() => router.push(me === null ? `/post/${post.id}` : `/post/${post.id}?reply=1`));

  /** Marks a kind busy if its request is still out after 400 ms, and returns the function that ends it. */
  const pending = (kind: ToggleKind | "delete") => {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setBusy((current) => ({ ...current, [kind]: true })), PENDING_MS);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      setBusy((current) => ({ ...current, [kind]: false }));
    };
  };
  const play = (kind: ToggleKind, next: Omit<IconButtonFeedback, "at">) => setFeedback((current) => ({ ...current, [kind]: { ...next, at: (current[kind]?.at ?? 0) + 1 } }));

  function toggle(kind: ToggleKind) {
    if (!me) {
      router.push("/signin");
      return;
    }
    // A second tap while this kind's request is out is not sent (lib/social.ts, lanes), and changes nothing on screen.
    if (lanes.busy(laneKey.post(post.id, kind))) return;
    const moves = kind !== "bookmark";
    const done = pending(kind);
    void toggleEngagement(social, lanes, post, kind, setPost, (on) => {
      // Touch and sight on the same frame: the haptic before the state changes, the motion with it.
      haptic(on ? "toggleOn" : "toggleOff");
      play(kind, { turn: on ? "on" : "off", pop: kind === "like" ? "springLike" : "springToggle", count: moves ? (on ? 1 : -1) : 0 });
    }).then((result) => {
      done();
      if (result.status === "busy") return;
      if (result.status === "answered") {
        setRefused(false);
        // Saved: a polite toast says it worked, with the way to the saved posts; unsaving says nothing.
        if (kind === "bookmark" && result.on) toast.show({ message: UI_WORDS["toast.saved"], action: { label: UI_WORDS["toast.view"], onPress: () => router.push("/bookmarks") } });
        return;
      }
      const err = result.error;
      haptic("error");
      play(kind, { turn: "back", count: moves ? (result.on ? -1 : 1) : 0 });
      // A suspension is said under the card in the standing's words; trying again would not help, so no toast says to.
      if (isSuspendedRefusal(err)) setRefused(true);
      else toast.show({ message: failedWords(kind, result.on), tone: "rollback" });
    });
  }

  // The card fades (post-removed, 150 ms; at once under reduced motion) before its list lets it go.
  const opacity = useSharedValue(1);
  const leave = () =>
    new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      if (motion.reduced) {
        resolve();
        return;
      }
      opacity.value = withTiming(0, motion.timing("easeOut", 150), (finished) => {
        "worklet";
        if (finished) runOnJS(resolve)();
      });
    });
  const removedStyle = useAnimatedStyle(() => ({ opacity: opacity.value }));

  function remove() {
    const done = pending("delete");
    void deleteWithLeave(social, lanes, post.id, leave).then((result) => {
      done();
      if (result.status === "deleted") {
        onDeleted?.(post.id);
        return;
      }
      if (result.status === "refused") {
        const err = result.error;
        setRefused(isSuspendedRefusal(err));
        setError(isSuspendedRefusal(err) ? null : errorMessage(err));
      }
    });
  }

  // The press wash of the card's body (section 5.1): after 80 ms, gone again on 10 px of movement, so a scroll never flashes it.
  const wash = useRef<{ timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>; x: number; y: number } | null>(null);
  const unwash = () => {
    if (wash.current) clearTimeout(wash.current.timer);
    wash.current = null;
    setWashed(false);
  };
  const webPress =
    Platform.OS === "web"
      ? {
          onClick: opensOnClick(openPost),
          onPointerDown: (event: PointerEvent & { target: Element; currentTarget: Element }) => {
            const control = event.target.closest?.(CONTROL);
            if (control && event.currentTarget.contains(control)) return;
            unwash();
            wash.current = { timer: setTimeout(() => setWashed(true), 80), x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
          },
          onPointerMove: (event: PointerEvent) => {
            if (wash.current && Math.hypot(event.clientX - wash.current.x, event.clientY - wash.current.y) > 10) unwash();
          },
          onPointerUp: unwash,
          onPointerCancel: unwash,
          onPointerLeave: unwash,
        }
      : {};

  const media = <MediaGrid media={post.media} postId={post.id} own={post.author.id === me} />;
  const quote = post.quoteOf ? <QuoteEmbed quote={post.quoteOf} /> : null;
  const stats = large ? threadStats(post.counts, hideCounts) : "";
  const when = postedWhen(post.createdAt);

  const actions = (
    // It wraps rather than cutting More off at the largest text on the narrowest phone.
    <View className="-ml-2.5 mt-1 flex-row flex-wrap items-center">
      <IconButton icon="reply" label={countLabel("reply", post.counts.replies, hideCounts)} count={shownCount("reply", post.counts.replies, hideCounts)} onPress={reply} />
      <Menu
        label={countLabel("repost", post.counts.reposts, hideCounts)}
        title={UI_WORDS["post.repost"]}
        icon="repost"
        items={repostMenuItems(post, me !== null, () => toggle("repost"))}
        trigger={{ pressed: viewer.reposted, disc: viewer.reposted, tone: viewer.reposted ? "accent" : "low", count: shownCount("repost", post.counts.reposts, hideCounts), busy: busy.repost === true, feedback: feedback.repost }}
      />
      <IconButton
        icon="like"
        label={countLabel("like", post.counts.likes, hideCounts)}
        count={shownCount("like", post.counts.likes, hideCounts)}
        pressed={viewer.liked}
        filled={viewer.liked}
        busy={busy.like === true}
        feedback={feedback.like}
        onPress={() => toggle("like")}
      />
      <IconButton
        icon="bookmarks"
        label={viewer.bookmarked ? UI_WORDS["post.saved"] : UI_WORDS["post.save"]}
        tone={viewer.bookmarked ? "accent" : "low"}
        filled={viewer.bookmarked}
        busy={busy.bookmark === true}
        feedback={feedback.bookmark}
        onPress={() => toggle("bookmark")}
      />
      <View className="flex-1" />
      <PostMenu post={post} onDelete={() => setConfirmingDelete(true)} triggerRef={moreRef} />
    </View>
  );

  const content: ReactNode = (
    <>
      {repostedBy ? <RepostLine by={repostedBy} /> : null}
      <View className="flex-row gap-2">
        {/* The avatar opens the profile too, but the name is the one keyboard and screen-reader target. */}
        <Link href={`/u/${post.author.handle}`} asChild>
          <Pressable tabIndex={-1} aria-hidden className="h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full">
            <Avatar account={post.author} size={40} />
          </Pressable>
        </Link>
        <View className="min-w-0 flex-1">
          <AuthorLine author={post.author} createdAt={post.createdAt} postId={post.id} large={large} open />
          {post.imported ? <ImportedLine label={post.imported} onPress={() => setProvenance({ mounted: true, open: true })} /> : null}
          {own && (post.state !== "visible" || post.inExplore) ? (
            <View className="flex-row flex-wrap gap-x-2">
              <StateChip post={post} />
              {/* The API sets inExplore only on the viewer's own posts; the check keeps the chip on them whatever a view carries. */}
              {post.inExplore ? <StatusChip tone="explore" label={UI_WORDS["post.inExplore"]} href={`/post/${post.id}`} /> : null}
            </View>
          ) : null}
          {post.replyTo ? (
            <Text variant="meta" tone="low">
              {post.replyTo.authorHandle ? UI_WORDS["post.replyingTo"] : UI_WORDS["post.replyingHidden"]}
              {post.replyTo.authorHandle ? (
                <Link href={`/u/${post.replyTo.authorHandle}`} asChild>
                  <Inline className={cn(INLINE_LINK, "text-accent-ink")}>@{post.replyTo.authorHandle}</Inline>
                </Link>
              ) : null}
            </Text>
          ) : null}
          {/* A post may consist of images only, and then there is no text. */}
          {post.body ? (
            <View className="mt-1.5">
              {/* 3b (5.3, 10.6): an imported post's @names belong to another platform and never link. */}
              <RichText body={post.body} variant={large ? "post-large" : "post"} mentions={post.imported === null} />
            </View>
          ) : null}
          {phone ? null : media}
          {phone ? null : quote}
        </View>
      </View>
      {phone ? media : null}
      {phone ? quote : null}
      {/* The stats, the actions and what they answer keep the content column's indent at every width. */}
      <View className="pl-[52px]">
        {stats ? (
          <Text variant="meta" tone="medium" className="mt-3">
            {stats}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
        {confirmingDelete ? (
          <DeleteQuestion postId={post.id} busy={busy.delete === true} onDelete={remove} onKeep={() => setConfirmingDelete(false)} keepRef={keepRef} />
        ) : (
          actions
        )}
        <ErrorText message={error} />
        {refused ? <RefusedNotice standing={state.status === "signed-in" ? state.me.standing : null} /> : null}
      </View>
      {provenance.mounted ? (
        <WhoSeesThis post={post} at="provenance" open={provenance.open} onClose={() => setProvenance({ mounted: true, open: false })} onClosed={() => setProvenance({ mounted: false, open: false })} />
      ) : null}
    </>
  );

  return (
    <Animated.View style={removedStyle}>
      <View
        role="article"
        aria-labelledby={labelId}
        aria-posinset={position}
        aria-setsize={position === undefined ? undefined : setSize}
        {...(webPress as object)}
        // A thread's focused post draws no divider of its own: the thread's block under it does, after Quote this post.
        className={cn(joined ? "px-4 pb-1 pt-3" : large ? "px-4 py-3" : "border-b border-line-low px-4 py-3", "web:transition-colors web:duration-[120ms]", washed ? "bg-surface-2" : "")}
      >
        {/* The thread line, from under the avatar to the next post's avatar: 2 px, line-low, through the avatars' centre. */}
        {joined ? <View pointerEvents="none" aria-hidden className="absolute bottom-0 left-[37px] top-[60px] w-0.5 bg-line-low" /> : null}
        {/* The article's name, the author line as a screen reader should hear it; hidden, and named only through aria-labelledby. */}
        <Text nativeID={labelId} aria-hidden style={VISUALLY_HIDDEN}>
          {fill(UI_WORDS["post.label"], { name: post.author.displayName, handle: post.author.handle, when })}
        </Text>
        {/* The first rows of a list load their images first (11.2): the grid reads it, through the quote's too. */}
        <ImagePriority.Provider value={priority}>
          {Platform.OS === "web" ? (
            content
          ) : (
            // On native the body is one Pressable that the accessibility tree does not see: the time's link does its job there.
            <Pressable accessible={false} {...pressDelay(80)} onPress={openPost} className="-mx-4 -my-3 px-4 py-3 active:bg-surface-2">
              {content}
            </Pressable>
          )}
        </ImagePriority.Provider>
      </View>
    </Animated.View>
  );
}
```

### Replace `apps/app/src/lib/post-actions.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import type { EngagementResponse, FollowResponse, PostCounts, PostView, ViewerPostState } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { laneKey, type EngagementKind, type Lanes } from "./social";
import { UI_WORDS, fill, type UiWord } from "./ui-words";

/**
 * What the post's actions do to the card, as pure functions (UI design, sections 6.6 and 8.4): the optimistic change of a
 * toggle, the server's answer replacing the counts, the rollback of a refusal, the names and counts the buttons show, the
 * stats line of a thread's focused post, the rollback toasts' words, and the follow button's toggle. PostCard and
 * FollowButton call them with the app's social client and lanes; the tests call them with fakes, since a static render
 * cannot press.
 */
export type ToggleKind = EngagementKind;

const FLAG: Record<ToggleKind, keyof ViewerPostState> = { like: "liked", repost: "reposted", bookmark: "bookmarked" };
/** The count a toggle moves; Save has none. */
const COUNT: Partial<Record<ToggleKind, "likes" | "reposts">> = { like: "likes", repost: "reposts" };
const NO_VIEWER: ViewerPostState = { liked: false, reposted: false, bookmarked: false };

export function isOn(post: PostView, kind: ToggleKind): boolean {
  return (post.viewer ?? NO_VIEWER)[FLAG[kind]];
}

/**
 * The post with one toggle set to `on`, its count moved by one, never below zero; the post itself when it already is. 2d
 * (decision 26, 10.6): a count its author hid is null for this reader, and stays null: the press never makes up a number.
 */
export function turned(post: PostView, kind: ToggleKind, on: boolean): PostView {
  const viewer = post.viewer ?? NO_VIEWER;
  if (viewer[FLAG[kind]] === on) return post;
  const key = COUNT[kind];
  const count = key === undefined ? null : post.counts[key];
  const counts = key === undefined || count === null ? post.counts : { ...post.counts, [key]: Math.max(0, count + (on ? 1 : -1)) };
  return { ...post, viewer: { ...viewer, [FLAG[kind]]: on }, counts };
}

/** The optimistic change of a press: the toggle the other way, at once. */
export function flipped(post: PostView, kind: ToggleKind): PostView {
  return turned(post, kind, !isOn(post, kind));
}

/**
 * The server's answer: its counts replace the card's, so they never drift, and its state of this kind is the truth. The
 * other kinds keep the card's own state, since their requests may still be out and their answers will say.
 */
export function settled(current: PostView, kind: ToggleKind, answer: EngagementResponse): PostView {
  return { ...current, counts: answer.counts, viewer: { ...(current.viewer ?? NO_VIEWER), [FLAG[kind]]: answer.viewer[FLAG[kind]] } };
}

/** A refusal: this kind's state and count as they were before the press; anything else that changed meanwhile stays. */
export function restored(current: PostView, before: PostView, kind: ToggleKind): PostView {
  const key = COUNT[kind];
  const counts = key === undefined ? current.counts : { ...current.counts, [key]: before.counts[key] };
  return { ...current, counts, viewer: { ...(current.viewer ?? NO_VIEWER), [FLAG[kind]]: isOn(before, kind) } };
}

export type ToggleResult = { status: "busy" } | { status: "answered"; on: boolean } | { status: "refused"; on: boolean; error: unknown };

/**
 * One press of Like, Repost or Save: nothing while that kind's request is still out; otherwise `onStart` (the haptic and
 * the motion, before the change, so sight and touch land together), the change at once, the request in its lane, then
 * the answer's counts, or the rollback.
 */
export async function toggleEngagement(
  client: { engage: (id: string, kind: ToggleKind, on: boolean) => Promise<EngagementResponse> },
  lanes: Lanes,
  post: PostView,
  kind: ToggleKind,
  apply: (update: (current: PostView) => PostView) => void,
  onStart?: (on: boolean) => void,
): Promise<ToggleResult> {
  const key = laneKey.post(post.id, kind);
  if (lanes.busy(key)) return { status: "busy" };
  const on = !isOn(post, kind);
  onStart?.(on);
  apply((current) => turned(current, kind, on));
  const outcome = await lanes.run(key, () => client.engage(post.id, kind, on));
  if (outcome.status === "busy") return outcome;
  if (outcome.status === "answered") {
    apply((current) => settled(current, kind, outcome.answer));
    return { status: "answered", on };
  }
  apply((current) => restored(current, post, kind));
  return { status: "refused", on, error: outcome.error };
}

export type FollowResult = { status: "busy" } | { status: "answered"; answer: FollowResponse } | { status: "refused"; on: boolean; error: unknown };

/** Follow or unfollow, the same way: the label at once, the answer's state after, the old state back on a refusal. */
export async function toggleFollow(
  client: { setFollow: (handle: string, on: boolean) => Promise<FollowResponse> },
  lanes: Lanes,
  handle: string,
  following: boolean,
  apply: (following: boolean) => void,
): Promise<FollowResult> {
  const key = laneKey.follow(handle);
  if (lanes.busy(key)) return { status: "busy" };
  const on = !following;
  apply(on);
  const outcome = await lanes.run(key, () => client.setFollow(handle, on));
  if (outcome.status === "busy") return outcome;
  if (outcome.status === "answered") {
    apply(outcome.answer.following);
    return outcome;
  }
  apply(following);
  return { status: "refused", on, error: outcome.error };
}

export type DeleteResult = { status: "busy" } | { status: "deleted" } | { status: "refused"; error: unknown };

/**
 * Delete: the request in the post's delete lane; once the server has answered, the card leaves (`leave`, the
 * post-removed fade), and only then is the post deleted for its list. A refusal leaves the card where it is.
 */
export async function deleteWithLeave(client: { deletePost: (id: string) => Promise<unknown> }, lanes: Lanes, id: string, leave: () => Promise<void>): Promise<DeleteResult> {
  const outcome = await lanes.run(laneKey.post(id, "delete"), () => client.deletePost(id));
  if (outcome.status === "busy") return outcome;
  if (outcome.status === "refused") return { status: "refused", error: outcome.error };
  await leave();
  return { status: "deleted" };
}

type Counted = "reply" | "like" | "repost";

const COUNT_WORDS: Record<Counted, { many: UiWord; one: UiWord; none: UiWord }> = {
  reply: { many: "post.reply", one: "post.reply.one", none: "post.reply.none" },
  like: { many: "post.like", one: "post.like.one", none: "post.like.none" },
  repost: { many: "post.reposts", one: "post.reposts.one", none: "post.reposts.none" },
};

/** Whether the reader's setting hides this kind's count (decision 15: likes and reposts; replies lead to conversation). */
const hides = (kind: Counted, hideCounts: boolean): boolean => hideCounts && kind !== "reply";

/**
 * A button's name with its count: "Like, 12 likes", "Like, 1 like", and "Like" at zero, when the reader's setting hides the
 * count, and (2d, decision 26) when the post's author hid it, which the API answers as null.
 */
export function countLabel(kind: Counted, count: number | null, hideCounts: boolean): string {
  const words = COUNT_WORDS[kind];
  if (count === null || count <= 0 || hides(kind, hideCounts)) return UI_WORDS[words.none];
  if (count === 1) return UI_WORDS[words.one];
  return fill(UI_WORDS[words.many], { n: count });
}

/** The number a button shows beside its icon, or nothing at zero or when the count is hidden, by the reader or (null) by the author. */
export function shownCount(kind: Counted, count: number | null, hideCounts: boolean): number | undefined {
  return count !== null && count > 0 && !hides(kind, hideCounts) ? count : undefined;
}

/** The thread's stats line (8.3): "12 reposts, 4 quotes, 30 likes", each part left out at zero or when hidden (2d: null is hidden by the author). */
export function threadStats(counts: PostCounts, hideCounts: boolean): string {
  const parts: [number | null, UiWord, UiWord, boolean][] = [
    [counts.reposts, "thread.stats.reposts", "thread.stats.reposts.one", hideCounts],
    [counts.quotes, "thread.stats.quotes", "thread.stats.quotes.one", false],
    [counts.likes, "thread.stats.likes", "thread.stats.likes.one", hideCounts],
  ];
  return parts
    .flatMap(([n, many, one, hidden]): [number, UiWord, UiWord][] => (n !== null && n > 0 && !hidden ? [[n, many, one]] : []))
    .map(([n, many, one]) => (n === 1 ? UI_WORDS[one] : fill(UI_WORDS[many], { n })))
    .join(", ");
}

const FAILED: Record<ToggleKind, { on: UiWord; off: UiWord }> = {
  like: { on: "toast.failed.like", off: "toast.failed.unlike" },
  repost: { on: "toast.failed.repost", off: "toast.failed.unrepost" },
  bookmark: { on: "toast.failed.save", off: "toast.failed.unsave" },
};

/** The rollback toast's sentence (5.4, 8.6), naming the action the reader took. */
export function failedWords(kind: ToggleKind, on: boolean): string {
  return UI_WORDS[FAILED[kind][on ? "on" : "off"]];
}

export function followFailedWords(handle: string, on: boolean): string {
  return fill(UI_WORDS[on ? "toast.failed.follow" : "toast.failed.unfollow"], { handle });
}
```

```ts
    showInExplore: z.boolean(),

    retiredHandles: z.array(z.object({ handle: z.string(), retiredAt: at })),

     * format name, last in the profile for now (Task 3 puts the avatar before it).
     */
    sharePreviews: z.boolean(),
  }),
  posts: z.array(ExportedPost),
  likes: z.array(PostRef),
  reposts: z.array(PostRef),
  bookmarks: z.array(PostRef),
  following: z.array(HandleRef),
  blocks: z.array(HandleRef),
  mutes: z.array(HandleRef),
  /** The live sessions. `id` is the session's handle, as the session list names it; the hash of its token never leaves the server. */
  sessions: z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), createdAt: at, lastUsedAt: at, current: z.boolean() })),
  devices: z.array(z.object({ label: z.string().nullable(), platform: Platform, firstSeenAt: at, lastSeenAt: at })),
  /** The account's own security events: their kind and time, without the metadata. */
  events: z.array(z.object({ type: z.string(), at })),
  /** Ids of ready images whose file was not on disk when the archive was written. */
  missingMedia: z.array(z.string()),
  /**
   * What korbat's moderation holds for the account (3c design, section 7.11): the decisions about it that its Cases screen
   * lists, newest first, and its own reports and notices, newest first. Never another person's report, a reporter, a
   * notifier or a staff member. Added to korbat-export-1 without a new format name, last in the document: a reader that
   * does not know the member loses nothing by skipping it. `strikes` (3e) lists the account's strikes, newest first;
   * then `standing` its suspensions, terminations and reporting measures, newest first, `replies` its replies to them,

   */
  moderation: z.object({
    decisions: z.array(ExportedDecision),
    reports: z.array(ExportedReport),
    strikes: z.array(ExportedStrike),
    standing: z.array(ExportedStanding),
    replies: z.array(ExportedReply),
    reporting: ExportedReporting,
    /**
     * 3d (design, W.10): the account's refused uploads, newest first, each as its notice reads it (UploadRefusalView: the
     * day, the source, the kind of match, the objection, the end and the release as far as the account may be told of
     * them), with no file and no hash; and the releases about its posts or uploads that it may be told of, newest first.
     */
    uploads: z.array(UploadRefusalView),
    releases: z.array(ExportedRelease),
  }),
  /**
   * 3b (design, section 11.2): the account's imports, newest first, each as ExportedImport. Added to korbat-export-1
   * without a new format name, last in the document: a reader that does not know the member loses nothing by skipping it.
   */
  imports: z.array(ExportedImport),
  /**
   * 2d (design, section 11.2; decision 28): the account's Activity as korbat holds it: the seen marker (null before the
   * first visit), the settings (the defaults for an account that never changed them), and every entry it received that
   * korbat still holds, newest first and ungrouped, shown or not. Moderation entries are not repeated here: the
   * `moderation` member holds them. Added to korbat-export-1 without a new format name, last in the document.
   */
  activity: z.object({ seenAt: at.nullable(), settings: ActivitySettings, received: z.array(ExportedActivityEntry) }),
});
export type ExportFormat = z.infer<typeof ExportFormat>;
```

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { FORBIDDEN_FORMAT } from "./text";

/** Every code the auth endpoints can put in ErrorEnvelope.error.code. */
export const AuthErrorCode = z.enum([
  "invalid_code",
  "code_expired",
  "too_many_attempts",
  "invalid_credentials",
  "mfa_required",
  "invalid_mfa_code",
  "reauth_required",
  "csrf_failed",
  "turnstile_failed",
  "disposable_email",
  "age_requirement",
  "terms_required",
  "handle_taken",
  "handle_invalid",
  "handle_reserved",
  "password_too_short",
  "password_too_long",
  "password_breached",
  "password_check_unavailable",
  "staff_mfa_required",
  "onboarding_required",
  "mail_unavailable",
  "rate_limited",
  "handle_cooldown",
  "email_in_use",
  "phone_in_use",
  "badge_unavailable",
  "verify_unavailable",
  // Passkeys (1c design, sections 8 and 9).
  "passkey_invalid",
  "passkey_unsupported",
  "passkey_limit",
  "passkey_suspended",
  "passkey_not_found",
  "challenge_expired",
  // 3e (design, section 10.5): a handle korbat retired, refused to everyone, its former holder included; the social
  // module's handle change answers it too.
  "handle_retired",
]);
export type AuthErrorCode = z.infer<typeof AuthErrorCode>;

export const Platform = z.enum(["web", "ios", "android"]);
export type Platform = z.infer<typeof Platform>;

export const Role = z.enum(["user", "moderator", "admin"]);
export type Role = z.infer<typeof Role>;

/** Random id created once per app install. The server stores only a keyed hash of it. */
export const DeviceId = z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22,64}$/);
/** 32 random bytes as base64url without padding: flow ids, MFA tickets, single-use link tokens. */
export const OpaqueId = z.string().regex(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/);
export const Email = z.string().trim().toLowerCase().max(254).pipe(z.email());
export const EmailCode = z.string().regex(/^\d{6}$/);
export const TotpCode = z.string().regex(/^\d{6}$/);
/**
 * A phone number in E.164 once the spaces, hyphens and parentheses people type are dropped: a plus and
 * 7 to 15 digits, the first not zero. Whether the number exists is the verification provider's call.
 */
export const Phone = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .max(64)
  .transform((raw) => raw.replace(/[\s()-]/g, ""))
  .pipe(z.string().regex(/^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$/, "phone numbers are written like +447911123456"));
/** The six-digit code the verification provider texts to a phone; the development provider's is 000000. */
export const PhoneCode = z.string().regex(/^\d{6}$/);
export const RecoveryCode = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .toLowerCase()
  .regex(/^[a-z2-7]{4}-[a-z2-7]{4}-[a-z2-7]{4}$/);
/**
 * The prefix of a retired handle's placeholder (3e design, sections 6.2 and 10.1): the placeholder is the prefix and 12
 * lower-case hex digits made from the retirement's id, 20 characters, so it is a valid handle that every reader of a handle
 * reads unchanged. The handle rule reserves the whole prefix, so nobody can choose one, and a trigger refuses it to every
 * role but the migrator.
 */
export const RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX = "retired_";

/** Whether a handle has a placeholder's form: the prefix and exactly 12 lower-case hex digits. */
export function isRetiredPlaceholder(handle: string): boolean {
  if (!handle.startsWith(RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX)) return false;
  const digits = handle.slice(RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX.length);
  return digits.length === 12 && [...digits].every((digit) => "0123456789abcdef".includes(digit));
}

/** Handle rules (3-20 of a-z, 0-9, _; reserved names) are enforced by the flow so it can return a specific error code. */
export const HandleInput = z.string().trim().toLowerCase().min(1).max(64);
export const DisplayName = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .min(1)
  .max(50)
  .regex(/^[^\p{Cc}]+$/u)
  .refine((name) => !FORBIDDEN_FORMAT.test(name), { message: "invisible direction and spacing characters are not allowed" });
export const TurnstileToken = z.string().min(1).max(2048);
/** Length rules (12-128) are enforced by the flow so it can return password_too_short or password_too_long. */
export const PasswordInput = z.string().min(1).max(1024);

/**
 * A new bearer token after the server rotated the session. Present only for native clients; web
 * clients receive fresh cookies instead.
 */
export const RotatedToken = z.string().optional();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- email entry and sign-up

export const EmailStartRequest = z.object({
  email: Email,
  turnstileToken: TurnstileToken,
  deviceId: DeviceId,
  platform: Platform,
});
export type EmailStartRequest = z.infer<typeof EmailStartRequest>;

export const FlowResponse = z.object({ flowId: OpaqueId });
export type FlowResponse = z.infer<typeof FlowResponse>;

export const EmailVerifyRequest = z.object({ flowId: OpaqueId, code: EmailCode });
export type EmailVerifyRequest = z.infer<typeof EmailVerifyRequest>;

/** A session was issued. Native clients get the bearer token in the body; web clients only get cookies. */
export const SessionResult = z.object({
  result: z.literal("session"),
  mustReenrollMfa: z.boolean(),
  token: z.string().optional(),
});
export const MfaRequiredResult = z.object({ result: z.literal("mfa_required"), mfaTicket: OpaqueId });
export const SignupRequiredResult = z.object({ result: z.literal("signup_required") });

export const EmailVerifyResponse = z.discriminatedUnion("result", [SessionResult, MfaRequiredResult, SignupRequiredResult]);
export type EmailVerifyResponse = z.infer<typeof EmailVerifyResponse>;

export const SignInResponse = z.discriminatedUnion("result", [SessionResult, MfaRequiredResult]);
export type SignInResponse = z.infer<typeof SignInResponse>;

export const SignupCompleteRequest = z.object({
  flowId: OpaqueId,
  dateOfBirth: z.iso.date(),
  termsVersion: z.string().min(1).max(64),
});
export type SignupCompleteRequest = z.infer<typeof SignupCompleteRequest>;

export const Profile = z.object({ id: z.uuid(), handle: z.string(), displayName: z.string() });
export type Profile = z.infer<typeof Profile>;

export const OnboardingHandleRequest = z.object({ handle: HandleInput, displayName: DisplayName });
export type OnboardingHandleRequest = z.infer<typeof OnboardingHandleRequest>;

export const OnboardingHandleResponse = z.object({ profile: Profile, token: RotatedToken });
export type OnboardingHandleResponse = z.infer<typeof OnboardingHandleResponse>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- password

export const PasswordSigninRequest = z.object({
  email: Email,
  password: PasswordInput,
  turnstileToken: TurnstileToken,
  deviceId: DeviceId,
  platform: Platform,
});
export type PasswordSigninRequest = z.infer<typeof PasswordSigninRequest>;

export const PasswordSetRequest = z.object({ password: PasswordInput });
export type PasswordSetRequest = z.infer<typeof PasswordSetRequest>;

export const PasswordSetResponse = z.object({ token: RotatedToken });
export type PasswordSetResponse = z.infer<typeof PasswordSetResponse>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- MFA

export const TotpSetupResponse = z.object({
  otpauthUri: z.string().startsWith("otpauth://totp/"),
  qrSvg: z.string().startsWith("<svg"),
});
export type TotpSetupResponse = z.infer<typeof TotpSetupResponse>;

export const TotpCodeRequest = z.object({ code: TotpCode });
export type TotpCodeRequest = z.infer<typeof TotpCodeRequest>;

/**
 * Turning TOTP off takes no code (1c design, section 2): the route needs a level-2 re-authentication, which already spent
 * the current step. A code a client sends anyway is dropped.
 */
export const TotpDisableRequest = z.object({});
export type TotpDisableRequest = z.infer<typeof TotpDisableRequest>;

export const RecoveryCodesResponse = z.object({ recoveryCodes: z.array(RecoveryCode).length(10) });
export type RecoveryCodesResponse = z.infer<typeof RecoveryCodesResponse>;

export const TotpConfirmResponse = z.object({ recoveryCodes: z.array(RecoveryCode).length(10), token: RotatedToken });
export type TotpConfirmResponse = z.infer<typeof TotpConfirmResponse>;

/** Exactly one of `code` or `recoveryCode`. */
export const MfaVerifyRequest = z.union([
  z.strictObject({ mfaTicket: OpaqueId, code: TotpCode }),
  z.strictObject({ mfaTicket: OpaqueId, recoveryCode: RecoveryCode }),
]);
export type MfaVerifyRequest = z.infer<typeof MfaVerifyRequest>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- re-authentication

// ReauthRequest lives in passkeys.ts: its `passkey` variant needs AuthenticationResponseJSON, and having auth.ts import
// that would form a cycle (passkeys.ts already imports this file). ReauthResponse stays here, as it names no passkey type.

/**
 * What a re-authentication answers (1c design, section 7.2): the level the session holds now (2 when a second factor
 * stands beside a first within the window, or a user-verified passkey does), the rotated token for native clients (web
 * clients get fresh cookies instead), and, after a recovery code, that two-factor authentication should be set up again.
 */
export const ReauthResponse = z.object({
  level: z.union([z.literal(1), z.literal(2)]),
  token: RotatedToken,
  mustReenrollMfa: z.boolean().optional(),
});
export type ReauthResponse = z.infer<typeof ReauthResponse>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- sessions and account

export const SessionInfo = z.object({
  /**
   * The session's handle: a random id it keeps for its whole life, which `DELETE /api/auth/sessions/:id` takes. Never the
   * token's hash, which changes whenever the token rotates (at every re-authentication, for one), so a session listed
   * before a rotation can still be revoked after it.
   */
  id: z.uuid(),
  deviceLabel: z.string(),
  platform: Platform,
  createdAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  lastUsedAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  current: z.boolean(),
});
export type SessionInfo = z.infer<typeof SessionInfo>;

export const SessionsResponse = z.object({ sessions: z.array(SessionInfo) });
export type SessionsResponse = z.infer<typeof SessionsResponse>;

export const NotMeRequest = z.object({ token: OpaqueId });
export type NotMeRequest = z.infer<typeof NotMeRequest>;

/**
 * The signed-in account's own profile as /me returns it (the profile-editing routes answer the public ProfileView): the public facts
 * plus when the handle last changed (the app shows when the next change is allowed), whether the
 * verified badge is held, and whether the account's posts show in Explore (2c design, section 8), a
 * switch that is the author's own and never part of the public profile. 2d (9.3, decision 21): and beside it the
 * person's link-preview switch, off until they turn it on, which no public answer carries either.
 */
export const MeProfile = Profile.extend({ handleChangedAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(), verified: z.boolean(), showInExplore: z.boolean(), sharePreviews: z.boolean() });
export type MeProfile = z.infer<typeof MeProfile>;

/**
 * 3e (design, section 10.2): where the signed-in account's standing stands now, read from the ledger at the request and
 * never kept in a session or a cache, so the banner and a refusal's sentence are true of the row. `activeStrikes` counts
 * the strikes that count now. `measure` is the account's one standing measure that stands and has not ended (a
 * suspension or a termination), or null: its decision, kind and days (null for a termination); its state now (no start
 * yet because the notice mail's outcome is unknown, a start fixed and ahead, a start held by a reply sent in time, or
 * running); the earliest start its statement names, and its start and end once the database has fixed them (the end
 * null for a termination); the reply and whether one can still be sent; the last moment of its appeal while one can be
 * filed, and whether one waits. `reporting` (null until the reporting measures exist, and whenever neither stands): the
 * warning that counts and the restriction that runs. `handleRetired`: the profile holds a placeholder. Defined here
 * beside MeResponse, which the moderation contracts cannot be imported into without a cycle.
 */
export const AccountStanding = z.object({
  activeStrikes: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  measure: z
    .object({
      decisionId: z.uuid(),
      kind: z.enum(["suspend", "terminate"]),
      days: z.number().int().min(1).max(30).nullable(),
      state: z.enum(["unfixed", "announced", "held", "running"]),
      earliestStart: z.iso.datetime(),
      startsAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
      endsAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
      reply: z.object({ filedAt: z.iso.datetime(), onTime: z.boolean(), answeredAt: z.iso.datetime().nullable() }).nullable(),
      replyOpen: z.boolean(),
      appealUntil: z.iso.datetime().nullable(),
      appealPending: z.boolean(),
    })
    .nullable(),
  reporting: z
    .object({
      warning: z.object({ decisionId: z.uuid(), countsUntil: z.iso.datetime() }).nullable(),
      restriction: z.object({ decisionId: z.uuid(), until: z.iso.datetime() }).nullable(),
    })
    .nullable(),
  handleRetired: z.boolean(),
});
export type AccountStanding = z.infer<typeof AccountStanding>;

export const MeResponse = z.object({
  user: z.object({
    id: z.uuid(),
    email: z.email(),
    role: Role,
    onboarded: z.boolean(),
    mfaEnabled: z.boolean(),
    hasPassword: z.boolean(),
    /** How many passkeys the account holds (1c design, section 7.5): above zero the app offers a passkey re-authentication, at zero it suggests adding one. */
    passkeys: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  }),
  profile: MeProfile.nullable(),
  /** 3e: the account's standing, read fresh; null for an account without a profile and from an API built without the moderation module. */
  standing: AccountStanding.nullable(),
});
export type MeResponse = z.infer<typeof MeResponse>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- email change

/** The new address, under the sign-up rules. The flow refuses the current address and disposable ones. */
export const EmailChangeStartRequest = z.object({ email: Email });
export type EmailChangeStartRequest = z.infer<typeof EmailChangeStartRequest>;

export const EmailChangeVerifyRequest = z.object({ flowId: OpaqueId, code: EmailCode });
export type EmailChangeVerifyRequest = z.infer<typeof EmailChangeVerifyRequest>;

/** The address the account now has. */
export const EmailChangeResponse = z.object({ email: z.email() });
export type EmailChangeResponse = z.infer<typeof EmailChangeResponse>;

/**
 * The token from the link the email_changed notice sends to the old address. It is the only credential
 * the undo needs, since a passwordless account cannot sign in at the old address any more.
 */
export const EmailRevertRequest = z.object({ token: OpaqueId });
export type EmailRevertRequest = z.infer<typeof EmailRevertRequest>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- verified badge

export const BadgeStartRequest = z.object({ phone: Phone });
export type BadgeStartRequest = z.infer<typeof BadgeStartRequest>;

export const BadgeVerifyRequest = z.object({ flowId: OpaqueId, code: PhoneCode });
export type BadgeVerifyRequest = z.infer<typeof BadgeVerifyRequest>;

export const BadgeVerifyResponse = z.object({ verified: z.literal(true) });
export type BadgeVerifyResponse = z.infer<typeof BadgeVerifyResponse>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- account deletion

export const DeleteStartResponse = z.object({ flowId: OpaqueId });
export type DeleteStartResponse = z.infer<typeof DeleteStartResponse>;

/** The emailed code and the account's handle typed by the owner; the flow compares the handle case-insensitively. */
export const DeleteConfirmRequest = z.object({ flowId: OpaqueId, code: EmailCode, handle: HandleInput });
export type DeleteConfirmRequest = z.infer<typeof DeleteConfirmRequest>;
```

### Replace `packages/contracts/src/social.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { z } from "zod";
import { DisplayName, HandleInput } from "./auth";
import { ImportSource } from "./imports";
import { HiddenMedia, MEDIA_MAX_PER_POST, MediaAttachment, MediaView } from "./media";
import { RULE_IDS } from "./moderation";
import { FORBIDDEN_CONTROL, FORBIDDEN_FORMAT, normalizePostBody, postLength, visibleLength } from "./text";

/**
 * Every code the social endpoints add to ErrorEnvelope.error.code (plus the shared ones: invalid_request, not_found, rate_limited).
 * explore_refreshed (409) refuses a page of an Explore ranking that is no longer kept. account_suspended (403, 3e design,
 * section 10.5) refuses a write of an account while a suspension or termination of it runs; the media, auth and
 * moderation modules answer it too, as a code they share with this one.
 */
export const SocialErrorCode = z.enum(["post_unavailable", "not_author", "blocked", "self_target", "account_too_new", "explore_refreshed", "account_suspended"]);
export type SocialErrorCode = z.infer<typeof SocialErrorCode>;

/** Postgres returns lowercase ids; the canonical form, so a lookup by any spelling finds the row. */
export const PostId = z.uuid().transform((id) => id.toLowerCase());

/** A handle from a URL or a lookup box: an optional leading @, then the 3 to 20 characters handles may contain. */
export const HandleParam = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  .regex(/^@?[A-Za-z0-9_]{3,20}$/)
  .transform((value) => value.replace(/^@/, "").toLowerCase());

export const POST_MAX_LENGTH = 1000;

// 3b Task 1: postLength, normalizePostBody and FORBIDDEN_CONTROL live in ./text, so that imports.ts can read the body rules
// without loading this module, which reads moderation.ts at load.

/** A post body as stored: normalized, 1 to 1000 code points, some of them visible, no control or disguising characters. */
export const PostBody = z
  .string()
  .max(4000)
  .transform(normalizePostBody)
  .refine((body) => !FORBIDDEN_CONTROL.test(body), { message: "control characters are not allowed" })
  .refine((body) => !FORBIDDEN_FORMAT.test(body), { message: "invisible direction and spacing characters are not allowed" })
  .refine((body) => visibleLength(body) >= 1, { message: "a post needs some text" })
  .refine((body) => postLength(body) <= POST_MAX_LENGTH, { message: `posts have at most ${POST_MAX_LENGTH} characters` });

/** The text of a post that may also carry images: the same rule as PostBody, except that it may be empty. */
export const PostText = z
  .string()
  .max(4000)
  .transform(normalizePostBody)
  .refine((body) => !FORBIDDEN_CONTROL.test(body), { message: "control characters are not allowed" })
  .refine((body) => !FORBIDDEN_FORMAT.test(body), { message: "invisible direction and spacing characters are not allowed" })
  .refine((body) => postLength(body) <= POST_MAX_LENGTH, { message: `posts have at most ${POST_MAX_LENGTH} characters` });

/** A new post, reply or quote: text, up to four images that are ready, or both. */
export const CreatePostRequest = z
  .object({
    body: PostText.default(""),
    replyToId: PostId.optional(),
    quoteOfId: PostId.optional(),
    media: z.array(MediaAttachment).max(MEDIA_MAX_PER_POST).default([]),
    /** 2d (decision 26, 10.6): the composer's "Hide like and repost counts", off unless sent. */
    hideCounts: z.boolean().default(false),
  })
  .refine((post) => !(post.replyToId && post.quoteOfId), { message: "a post is a reply or a quote, not both", path: ["quoteOfId"] })
  .refine((post) => visibleLength(post.body) >= 1 || post.media.length >= 1, { message: "a post needs text or an image", path: ["body"] })
  .refine((post) => new Set(post.media.map((item) => item.id)).size === post.media.length, { message: "an image can be attached once", path: ["media"] });
export type CreatePostRequest = z.infer<typeof CreatePostRequest>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- posts

export const Author = z.object({ id: z.uuid(), handle: z.string(), displayName: z.string(), verified: z.boolean() });
export type Author = z.infer<typeof Author>;

/** Stands in for a post where its absence would break structure: an ancestor in a thread or a quoted embed. */
export const Tombstone = z
  .strictObject({ id: z.uuid(), deleted: z.literal(true).optional(), unavailable: z.literal(true).optional() })
  .refine((t) => t.deleted === true || t.unavailable === true, { message: "a tombstone is deleted or unavailable" });
export type Tombstone = z.infer<typeof Tombstone>;

/** Never deleted_by_author: deleted posts only ever appear as tombstones. */
export const PostState = z.enum(["visible", "withheld", "removed"]);
export type PostState = z.infer<typeof PostState>;

/**
 * A post's counts. 2d (decision 26, 9.3): `likes` and `reposts` are null exactly when the post's author hid its counts and
 * the reader is not its author, in every answer that carries counts (a view, a quoted embed, and the answer to the
 * reader's own like, unlike, repost or unrepost), so no reader learns a hidden count by liking. Replies and quotes are
 * always numbers.
 */
export const PostCounts = z.object({
  likes: z.number().int().min(0).nullable(),
  reposts: z.number().int().min(0).nullable(),
  replies: z.number().int().min(0),
  quotes: z.number().int().min(0),
});
export type PostCounts = z.infer<typeof PostCounts>;

export const ViewerPostState = z.object({ liked: z.boolean(), reposted: z.boolean(), bookmarked: z.boolean() });
export type ViewerPostState = z.infer<typeof ViewerPostState>;

const postFields = {
  id: z.uuid(),
  author: Author,
  body: z.string(),
  createdAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  state: PostState,
  /** The handle is null when the viewer could not open the parent: its author is blocked either way, or it is hidden or deleted. */
  replyTo: z.object({ id: z.uuid(), authorHandle: z.string().nullable() }).nullable(),
  counts: PostCounts,
  /** The post's images in order, each as the image or, where the reader is not shown it, as a hidden image in its place. Always present, often empty. */
  media: z.array(z.union([MediaView, HiddenMedia])),
  /** Present only for a signed-in viewer. */
  viewer: ViewerPostState.optional(),
};

/**
 * 3b (design, sections 8.4, 9.3 and 10.6): the provenance label of an imported post, made from the post's own columns and
 * nothing else: its source, the archive's day (YYYY-MM-DD in UTC, never its second, which with the text would fingerprint
 * the original) and whether it was cut to 1,000 characters on import. Null on every native post.
 */
export const ImportedLabel = z.object({ source: ImportSource, at: z.iso.date(), shortened: z.boolean() });
export type ImportedLabel = z.infer<typeof ImportedLabel>;

/**
 * A quoted post as embedded: one level deep, so its own quote is not expanded. 3b (the orchestrator's ruling for Task 6):
 * it carries the label as PostView does, last, for QuoteEmbed's short line (10.6).
 */
export const QuotedPost = z.object({ ...postFields, quoteOf: z.null(), imported: ImportedLabel.nullable() });
export type QuotedPost = z.infer<typeof QuotedPost>;

/**
 * The decision behind the state of the viewer's own withheld or removed post (3c design, sections 5 and 7.6): the decision
 * of the strongest post measure in force, by its id, the rule it cites (null for a decision on the law), whether it rests
 * on the law, and whether korbat is still deciding. The app shows it as the chip that links to the statement. `strikeUntil`
 * (3e design, section 10.2) is the end of counting of the strike the post's decision gave, while that strike stands and
 * still counts; null otherwise.
 */
// 3f: `order` is true when the chip's decision gives effect to an authority's order (a DSA Article 9 order that does not
// withhold, the only order that leaves a post its author sees), so the chip reads [chip.order]; absent otherwise.
export const PostModeration = z.object({ decisionId: z.uuid(), ruleId: z.enum(RULE_IDS).nullable(), legal: z.boolean(), interim: z.boolean(), strikeUntil: z.iso.datetime().nullable(), order: z.boolean().optional() });
export type PostModeration = z.infer<typeof PostModeration>;

export const PostView = z.object({
  ...postFields,
  /**
   * The author's "In Explore" chip (2c design, section 8): present, and true, only on the viewer's own post while it is in
   * the current Explore ranking with their switch on. Nobody else's view carries it, nor does a quoted embed. It sits here
   * rather than in `viewer`, which the like, repost and bookmark answers replace.
   */
  inExplore: z.literal(true).optional(),
  /** Present only on the viewer's own post while moderation withholds or removed it; nobody else's view carries it, nor does a quoted embed. */
  moderation: PostModeration.optional(),
  quoteOf: z.union([QuotedPost, Tombstone]).nullable(),
  /** 3b (9.3): the provenance label of an imported post, last; null on a native post. */
  imported: ImportedLabel.nullable(),
  /**
   * 2d (4.3): the handles of the post's stored mentions that link for this reader, lowercased, in text order: each one's
   * account is live, still holds the handle as written, and (for a signed-in reader) has no block either way with the
   * reader. Always empty for an imported post. After the label; a quoted embed carries none (QuotedPost), since it draws
   * its text plain.
   */
  mentions: z.array(z.string()),
  /** 2d (decision 26): the author hid the like and repost counts; last. Anyone else then reads them as null (PostCounts). */
  countsHidden: z.boolean(),
});
export type PostView = z.infer<typeof PostView>;

/** An item of a timeline or a profile's Posts tab. */
export const TimelineItem = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("post"), post: PostView }),
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("repost"), post: PostView, repostedBy: Author, repostedAt: z.iso.datetime() }),
]);
export type TimelineItem = z.infer<typeof TimelineItem>;

export function page<T extends z.ZodType>(item: T) {
  return z.object({ items: z.array(item), nextCursor: z.string().nullable() });
}

export const TimelinePage = page(TimelineItem);
export type TimelinePage = z.infer<typeof TimelinePage>;
export const PostPage = page(PostView);
export type PostPage = z.infer<typeof PostPage>;

export const ThreadResponse = z.object({
  ancestors: z.array(z.union([PostView, Tombstone])),
  post: PostView,
  replies: PostPage,
});
export type ThreadResponse = z.infer<typeof ThreadResponse>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- engagement and graph

export const EngagementResponse = z.object({ counts: PostCounts, viewer: ViewerPostState });
export type EngagementResponse = z.infer<typeof EngagementResponse>;

/** 2d (9.2): PATCH /api/posts/:id/counts, the author's switch of decision 26; its answer is CountsResponse. */
export const CountsRequest = z.object({ hidden: z.boolean() });
export type CountsRequest = z.infer<typeof CountsRequest>;
export const CountsResponse = z.object({ countsHidden: z.boolean() });
export type CountsResponse = z.infer<typeof CountsResponse>;

/** 2d (9.2, decision 21): what POST and DELETE /api/me/share-previews answer, as /api/me/explore answers its switch. */
export const SharePreviewsResponse = z.object({ sharePreviews: z.boolean() });
export type SharePreviewsResponse = z.infer<typeof SharePreviewsResponse>;

export const FollowResponse = z.object({ following: z.boolean(), followerCount: z.number().int().min(0) });
export type FollowResponse = z.infer<typeof FollowResponse>;

export const BlockResponse = z.object({ blocked: z.boolean() });
export type BlockResponse = z.infer<typeof BlockResponse>;

export const MuteResponse = z.object({ muted: z.boolean() });
export type MuteResponse = z.infer<typeof MuteResponse>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- profiles

export const ProfileCounts = z.object({
  posts: z.number().int().min(0),
  followers: z.number().int().min(0),
  following: z.number().int().min(0),
});

export const ViewerProfileState = z.object({ following: z.boolean(), followedBy: z.boolean(), blocked: z.boolean(), muted: z.boolean() });
export type ViewerProfileState = z.infer<typeof ViewerProfileState>;

export const ProfileView = z.object({
  id: z.uuid(),
  handle: z.string(),
  displayName: z.string(),
  bio: z.string(),
  verified: z.boolean(),
  createdAt: z.iso.datetime(),
  counts: ProfileCounts,
  /**
   * 3b (9.3, 10.6): the account has a visible imported top-level post, so the profile shows its Imported tab, for every
   * reader alike.
   */
  hasImported: z.boolean(),
  /** Present only for a signed-in viewer looking at someone else. */
  viewer: ViewerProfileState.optional(),
});
export type ProfileView = z.infer<typeof ProfileView>;

export const ProfileListItem = Author.extend({ bio: z.string(), viewerFollows: z.boolean().optional() });
export type ProfileListItem = z.infer<typeof ProfileListItem>;

export const ProfilePage = page(ProfileListItem);
export type ProfilePage = z.infer<typeof ProfilePage>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- profile editing

export const BIO_MAX_LENGTH = 160;

/** A bio as stored: trimmed, at most 160 code points, one line of plain text with no control or disguising characters. Empty clears it. */
export const Bio = z
  .string()
  .trim()
  // The line and paragraph separators (Zl, Zp) break a line as a newline does, without being control characters.
  .regex(/^[^\p{Cc}\p{Zl}\p{Zp}]*$/u, "control characters and line breaks are not allowed")
  .refine((bio) => !FORBIDDEN_FORMAT.test(bio), { message: "invisible direction and spacing characters are not allowed" })
  .refine((bio) => postLength(bio) <= BIO_MAX_LENGTH, { message: `bios have at most ${BIO_MAX_LENGTH} characters` });

/** What the profile screen saves: either field, or both. The handle has its own route and rules. */
export const ProfileEditRequest = z
  .object({ displayName: DisplayName.optional(), bio: Bio.optional() })
  .refine((edit) => edit.displayName !== undefined || edit.bio !== undefined, { message: "nothing to change" });
export type ProfileEditRequest = z.infer<typeof ProfileEditRequest>;

/** The handle rules and the 30-day cooldown are enforced by the flow, which answers with a specific error code. */
export const HandleChangeRequest = z.object({ handle: HandleInput });
export type HandleChangeRequest = z.infer<typeof HandleChangeRequest>;
```
